406.ru:
**429\. Atha pubbāni vibhattīnaṃ cha parassapadāni** (865).

**Atha** taddhitānantaraṃ vuccamānānaṃ sabbāsaṃ **vattamānā**dīnaṃ aṭṭhavidhānaṃ vibhattīnaṃ yāni yāni pubbakāni **cha** padāni, tāni tāni atthato aṭṭhacattālīsamattāni **parassapada**saññāni hontī ti ādimhi channaṃ **parassapada**saññā, parassatthāni padāni **parassapadāni**, tabbāhullato tabbohāro.

“Dhātūhi ṇe ṇaya” icc ādito “dhātūhī” ti vattamāne.
406.nyasa: (406) **Atthapubbanivibhattīnaṃ chaparasāpadāni** : : Kimatthamidamuccate, itoparaṃ vuccamānānaṃ vitattigaṇanaṃ yāniyāni purimānichapadāni, tānitāninipara-ssapadasaññānihontītiñāpanattúaṃ. Pañcapadamidaṃsuttaṃ. Itoparaṃ vibhattīnaṃ pubbāni chaparassapadasaññānihontī tyattho. Athaityayaṃnipātomariyādattho, tena itopaṭṭhāyātyatthoyujjati. Vuttā pekkhovā vuccamānāpekkhovā yadipana vuttā pekk-ho siyā, taddhitakappassavuttānantarantyattho. Athavuccamānāpekkho siyā, uparivu-ccamānānantarantyattho. Pakatihesācariyānaṃ, tatthatatthaadhikārantaraviññāpana-tthaṃ athaggahaṇakaranaṃ. Parassatthānipadāniparassapadāni. Alopasamāsoyaṃ. Tānipanatthatovattamānānicha, pañcamiyocha, sattamiyocha, parokkhācha, hiyyattani yocha, ajjataniyocha, bhavissantiyocha, kālātipattiyochāti, aṭṭhacattālīsaṃhonti. Etthacuttamapurisokiñcāpiattanoatthaṃvadati, tathāpiitarānaṃ bahukatarattātabbase-natabbohāroniropitotidaṭṭhabbaṃ. Ayaṃpanaporāṇakavohāro. Idaṃpanasuttaṃ katta-riparassapadantyādīsu imesaṃgahaṇatthaṃ.

407.ru:
**439\. Parāṇy attanopadāni** (866).

Sabbāsaṃ vattamānādīnaṃ aṭṭhavidhānaṃ vibhattīnaṃ yāni yāni parāni cha padāni, tāni tāni **attanopada**saññāni hontī ti **te**\-ādīnaṃ **attanopada**saññā.

“Dhātūhi,” “attanopadānī” ti ca vattate.
407.nyasa:
(407) **Parānyattanopadāni**: :Kimatthamidaṃ, yāniyānivitattīnaṃparānicha-padāni tānitāni attanopadasaññānihontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Vibhattigga-haṇañca chaggahaṇañcavattate. Tenayāniyānivibhattīnaṃ parānichapadāni tānitāni attanopada saññāni hontītyattho. Atthano atthani padāni attattanopadāni, alopasamā-soyaṃ. Tānipanaatthatovuttanayena aṭṭhacattālīsaṃvahonti.
[p. 318]
Etthacakiñcāpipaṭhama-majjhimapurisaparassatthā, tathāpitabbotārassa itaresu-nirūhattāca imassapanimesaṃ porāṇakavohārattāca saṅkara dosāpagamakaraṇatthañ-cāyamimesamāropitotidaṭṭhabbaṃ. Idaṃpana attanopadānibhāvecakammanityādisvi-mesaṃgahaṇatthaṃ.

408.ru:
**431\. Dve dve paṭhama-majjhim’-uttamapurisā** (867) \[VI 14\].

Tāsaṃ vibhattīnaṃ parassapadānam attanopadānañ ca **dve dve** vacanāni yathākkamaṃ **paṭhama-majjhim’-uttamapurisa**saññāni honti. Taṃ yathā? **Ti anti** iti paṭhamapurisā, **si tha** iti majjhimapurisā, **mi ma** iti uttamapurisā. Attanopadesu pi **te ante** iti paṭhamapurisā, **se vhe** iti majjhimapurisā, **e mhe** iti uttamapurisā. Evaṃ sesāsu sattasu vibhattīsu pi yojetabban ti. Evaṃ aṭṭhavibhattivasena channavutividhe ākhyātapade dvattiṃsa dvattiṃsa paṭhama-majjhima-uttamapurisā hontī ti vattamāna-parassapadādimhi dvinnaṃ paṭhamapurisasaññā.
408.nyasa: (408) **Dve Dve Paṭhamamajjhimuttama Purisā**: : Kimatthamida tāsaṃ sabbāsaṃvibhattīnaṃ dvedvepaṭhamamajjhimuttamapurisasaññānihonti ti ñāpanatth-aṃ. Ti padamidaṃ. Atttho ca viggahoca suviññeyova. Tatthaca paṭhamapurisā nāma-duttiṃsa, tathāmajjhimapurisā, tathāuttamapurisā. Imesaṃpana paṭhamapurisāda-yovohārāporāṇakāva. Idhaṃpana-suttaṃ nāmamhi payujjamānepi tulyāmikaraṇepaṭhamotumhemajjhimo amheuttamotyā-dīsvimesaṃgahaṇatthaṃ. Imassapana suttassa devadattopacati, devadattāpacanti, tvaṃpacasi. Tumhepacatha ahaṃ pacāmi,mayaṃpacāma. Devadattopacate, devadattā pacante, tvaṃ pacase, tumhepacavhe. Ahaṃ pace. Mayaṃ pacāmhetyādīnivisayāni.

409.ru:
**441\. Sabbesam ekābhidhāne paro puriso** (868) \[I 22\].

Sabbesaṃ paṭhama-majjhimānaṃ, paṭham’-uttamānaṃ, majjhim’-uttamānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ vā purisānaṃ ekatobhidhāne kātabbe paro puriso yojetabbo. Ekakālānam evā ‘bhidhāne cā ‘yaṃ. So ca pacati, tvañ ca pacasī ti pariyāyappasaṅge **tumhe pacathā** ti bhavati. Evaṃ so ca pacati, ahañ ca pacāmī ti **mayaṃ pacāma**, tathā tvañ ca pacasi, ahañ ca pacāmi, **mayaṃ pacāma**, so ca pacati, tvañ ca pacasi, ahañ ca pacāmi, **mayaṃ pacāma**. Evaṃ sabbattha yojetabbaṃ.

**Ekābhidhāne** ti kimatthaṃ? “So ca pacati, tvañ ca pacissasi, ahaṃ paciṃ” ettha bhinnakālattā “mayaṃ pacimhā” ti na bhavati.

**Gamu sappa** gatimhi, pure viya dhātusaññāyaṃ dhātvantalopo.

Kattari **ty**ādyuppatti.
409.nyasa:
(409) **Sabbesamekābhidhāneparopuriso** : :Kimatthamidaṃ, sabbesaṃpa-ṭhamamajjhi muttamapurisānaṃtulyābhidhāneparopuriso yojetabbotiñāpanattaṃ. Ca-tuppadamida. Atthocaviggahoca suviññeyyova. Imassa panasocapaṭhati, tecapaṭhantī tyādayovisayā. Tumhe *paṭhathaityādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca tumhepaṭhathāti tum-hasaddūpa padassapaṭha viyattiyaṃ vācāyamitimassa laddhadhātusaññādissāneka paccayappasaṅgevuttenayena vattamānaparassapadasaññaṃ katvā soca paṭhati tvañcapaṭhasītivuttattā paṭhamamajjhimapurisappasaṅge iminā majjhimapurisaba-huvacanaṃkatvā bhūvā dito aityapaccayaṃkatvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. Tumhe pacatha ityatrapanadhātumattamevaviseso.Vuttiyaṃpaṭhama majjhimānappasaṅge majjhimo payojito. Itaresupana evaṃnayo netabbo, socapaṭhati ahañcapaṭhāmimayaṃpaṭhāma. Tvañcapaṭhasiahañcapaṭhāmimayaṃpaṭhāma. Socapaṭhatitvañcapaṭhasiahañcapaṭhami mayaṃpaṭhama. Socapaṭhatitecapaṭhanti tvañcapaṭhasitumhecapaṭhatha ahañcapa-ṭhāmi, mayaṃpaṭhāma itiiminānayena sesāsuvibhattīsu pañcamīsattamī parokkhāhi-yyattanīajjatanībhavissanti kālātipattisaṅkhātāsu paropuriso
[p. 319]
yojetabbo. Vuttañca vuttiyaṃ evaṃsesāsuvibhattīsu paropuriso yojetabboti.

410.ru:
**432\. Nāmamhi payujjamāne pi tulyādhikaraṇe paṭhamo** (869).

**Tumhāmha**saddavajjite tulyādhikaraṇabhūte sādhakavācake nāmamhi payujjamāne pi appayujjamāne pi dhātūhi paṭhamapuriso hotī ti paṭhamapurisaṃ katvā, tass’ āpy aniyamappasaṅge kriyāsādhakassa kattuno ekatte vattum icchite “ekamhi vattabbe ekavacanan” ti vattamāna-parassapada-paṭhamapurisekavacanaṃ **ti**.

“Paro,” “paccayo,” “dhātū” ti ca adhikāro, “yathā kattari cā” ti ito “kattarī” ti vikaraṇappaccayavidhāne sabbattha vattate.
410.nyasa:
(410) **Nāmamhi Payujjamānepi Tulyādhikaraṅe Paṭhamo**: :Kimatthamidaṃ, tulyādhikaraṇa saṅkhātesādhakavācakenāmamhipayujjamā nepi appayujjamānepi sab-badhātūhi paṭhamapurisohotītiñāpanatthaṃ. Pañcapadamidaṃ. Atthoca viggahocasu-viññeyyova. Idhapanakiñcāpināmamhītya niyametvāvuttaṃ, tathāpitumhe majjhimo amheuttamoti vuttattāva tumhamhehivinimuttañño sādhakavācakaṃnāmamidhagahi-tantiveditabbaṃ. *Sogacchatītyādinyudāharaṇāni, tatthacasogacchatītitasaddūpapada-ssa gamusappagatimhītimassa bhūvādayodhātavoti laddhadhātu saññādissa dhātussa-nto lopone kasarassetiluttānubandhassa heṭṭhā vuttanayena tipaccayaṃ katvābhūvādi-toaityapaccayaṃ katvā gamissantocchovāsabbāsūtidhātvantassacchādesaṃkatvā netabbe nīte-rūpaṃ, te *gacchantītiettha bahuvacanakaraṇameva viseso. Imānicadve-nāmappayogavasena vuttāni, itarānipana dve asatipi nāmappayogetaṭṭhāniyavasena vuttāni. Tena *haññasetvanti kimudāharaṇaṃ. Taṃpana hana hiṃsāgatīsūtimassa laddhadhātusaññā dissa idhādhippetanāmappayogābhāvāpaṭhamapurisamakatvā tato neka paccayappasaṅge tyādīnaṃvuttanayenavattamānasaññaṃkatvā tesaṃ pyaniya-mappasaṅgesativatticchānupubbikā saddappaṭipattītikatvā parānyatta nopadā-nīti vibhattīnaṃparānaṃchannaṃ attano padasaññaṃ katvā attanopadānibhavecaka-mmanīti kammani attanopadaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappa saṅghe vuttanayena majjhimapurisasaññaṃ katvā nāmamhipayujja-māne pi tulyādhikaraṇepaṭhamoti vattamāne tumhe ajjhimoti majjhipurisaṃ katvā tassāpya niyamappasaṅge vuttanaye-na ekavacana sevibhattiṃ katvā bhāvakammesuyoti dhātumhāyapaccayaṃkatvā tamevādhi kicca tassaca vaggayakārattaṃ sadhātvantassātidhātvantena saha yakā-rassaca vaggaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅgesati dātvantassatavaggantattācava-ggantaṃ katvā paradvebhāvoṭhānetitassadvebhāvaṃkatvā netabbe nīterūpaṃ.
[p. 320]

411.ru:
**436\. Tumhe majjhimo** (870).

Tulyādhikaraṇabhūte **tumha**sadde payujjamāne pi appayujjamāne pi dhātūhi **majjhima**puriso hotī ti vattamāna-parassapada-majjhimapurisekavacanaṃ **si**, sesaṃ purimasamaṃ. Tvaṃ bhavasi, tumhe bhavatha, appayujjamāne pi bhavasi, bhavatha.

**Tulyādhikaraṇe** ti kimatthaṃ? Tayā paccate odano.

Tasmiṃ yev’ ādhikāre.
411.nyasa: (411) **Tumhemajjimo** : : Kimatthamidaṃ tulyādhikaraṇasaṅkhāte tum-hepayujjamānepi appayujjamānepi majjhimapuriso hotīti ñāpanatthaṃ. dvipadamidaṃ. payujjamānaggahaṇañca apiggahaṇañca tulyādhikaraṇaggahaṇañca vattate. Atthocaviggahoca suviññeyyova. Tvaṃ yāsītyādī nyndāharanāni, tattha-catvaṃyāsīti tumhasaddūpapadassayā pāpuṇanetimassaladdhadhātusaññādissaupapa-dassaheṭṭhāvuttanayenasyūpattiṃ katvā tvamādesekate tato dhātumhāneka paccayappasaṅge vuttanayena tyādīnaṃ vattamāna saññaṃ katvā vuttanayena vattamānapaccayekatvātesaṃ pyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayena majjhimapurisa saññaṃkatvā anantarasuttamadhikicciminā majjhimapurisaṃ katvā vuttanayena ekavacane kate rūpaṃ tumhe yāthātiettha bahuvacana karaṇameva viseso. Imāni-dvetumha saddappayogavasena vuttāni, itarānidvetaṭṭhāniyavasenavuttāni. Tayā *paccatetikimudāharaṇaṃ. Taṃpanapacapāketimassaladdhadhātusaññādissa idhādhi-ppeta tumhasaddappayogā bhāvāiminā majjhimapurisamakatvā anekapaccayappa-saṅge vuttanayena te ādīnaṃ attanopadasaññaṃkatvā vuttanayena attanopadaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayena paṭhamapuriseka vacanaṃkatvābhāva kamme-suyotiyapaccayaṃ katvā tassavuttanayenatassacavaggayakā ravakārattaṃ sadhātva-ntassetidhātvantenasaha yakārassavaggaṃ katvāvuttanayena dve bhāve kate rūpaṃ.

412.ru:
**437\. Amhe uttamo** (871).

Tulyādhikaraṇabhūte **amha**sadde payujjamāne pi appayujjamāne pi dhātūhi **uttama**puriso hotī ti vattamāna-parassapada-uttamapurisekavacanaṃ **mi**, **a**ppaccayavuddhi-**avā**desā.
412.nyasa:
(412) **Amhe Uttamo**: : Kimatthamidaṃ. Tulyādhikaraṇasaṅkhā te amha-saddamhi payujjamānepi taṭṭhāniyatthe sati appayujjamānepi uttamapuriso hotīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Payujjamānaggahañca apiggahaṇañca tulyādhikaraṇa-ggahaṇañca vattate. Attho suviññeyyova. Ahaṃ * yajāmītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca ahaṃyajāmīti amhasaddūpapadassa yaja deva pūjāsaṅgahakaraṇa dānadhammesūti-massa laddhadhātusaññādissa upapadassa vuttanayena syuppattiṃ katvā aha mādesekate dhātuto anekapaccayasaṅge vuttanayenatyādīnaṃ vattamānasaññaṃkatvā vuttanayenavattamānapaccayaṃkatvā tesaṃpyani yamappasaṅge vuttanayena parassapadasaññaṃkatvā kattariparassapadanti
[p. 321]
parassapadaṃkatvātassāpyaniyama-ppasaṅge vuttanayena uttamapurisasaññaṃ katvā nāmamhipayujjamānepi tulyādhi-karaṇepaṭhamoti vattamāne iminā uttamapurisaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅgesati vuttanayena ekavacanadhivibhattiṃkatvā bhūvādito ai tyapaccayaṃkatvā akārodī-ghaṃhimimesūtiakārassadīghaṃkatvānetabbe nīte rūpaṃ. Mayaṃ*yajāmāti etthaba-huvacanakaraṇameva viṃseso. Imānipanadveamha saddappayogavasenavuttāni, ita-rānidve amhasaddappayoge asati pitaṭhāniyavasenavuttāni. Mayā*ijjatebuddhoti-kimudāharanaṃ. Taṃpana tassevadhātussa amhasaddappayogābhāvā iminā uttama-purisamakatvā aneka paccayasaṅge vuttanayena tyādīnaṃvattamānasaññaṃ katvā vattamānāpaccuppannetivattamānapaccayekatvā tesaṃpyaniyamappasaṅgesativuttana-yena teādīnaṃ attanopadasaññaṃkatvāattanopadānibhāve-sa kammanti attānopadaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅgevuttanayena paṭhamapurisasa-ññaṃ katvānāmamhi payujjamānepi tulyādhi karaṇepaṭhamoti paṭhamapurisaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyama-ppasaṅgeekamhi vattabbeekavacananti ekavacanaṃ katvā bhāvakammesuyoti yapaccayaṃ katvā yamhidādhāmāṭhāhāpāmahamathādīnamītyanuvattamāneyajassā dissīti yajassādissikāraṃkatvā bhāvakammesuyo tyadhikicca tassacavaggayakārava-kārattaṃ sadhātvantasseti dhātvantenasaha yakārassacavaggaṃkatvāvuttenayena dvibhā-vañcakatvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ.

413.ru:
**427\. Kāle**.

Ayam adhikāro.

Ito paraṃ **ty**ādivibhattividhāne sabbattha vattate.
413.nyasa: (413) **Kāle**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, ye itoparaṃvakkhāma, tekāleyevaho-ntītiñāpanatthaṃ. Atthosuviññeyova. Adhikāroyaṃ.

414.ru:
**428\. Vattamānā paccuppanne** (872) \[VI 1\].

Paccuppanne kāle gamyamāne vattamānāvibhatti hoti, **kālo** ti c’ ettha kriyā, karaṇaṃ kāro, **ra**kārassa **la**kāro, kālo.

Tasmā:

		Kriyāya gamyamānāya, vibhattīnaṃ vidhānato;  
		Dhātūh’ eva bhavantī ti, siddhaṃ tyādivibhattiyo.

Idha pana kālassa atītānāgatapaccuppannāṇattiparikappakālātipattivasena chadhā bhinnattā “paccuppanne” ti viseseti. Taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ paṭicca uppanno **paccuppanno**, paṭiladdhasabhāvo, na tāva atīto ti attho.

		Paccuppannasamīpe pi, tabbohārūpacārato;  
		Vattamānā atīte pi, taṃ kālavacanicchayā ti.[^2]

Tasmiṃ paccuppanne vattamānāvibhattiṃ katvā, tassā ṭhānāniyame “dhātu-liṅgehi parā paccayā”[^3] ti paribhāsato dhātuto paraṃ vattamānappaccaye katvā, tesam aniyamappasaṅge sati “vatticchānupubbikā saddappaṭipattī” ti parassapadavacanicchāyaṃ.
414.nyasa:
(414) **Vattamānā paccuppanne** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, paccuppanne kālevatta-mānavibhatteyo hontīti. ©āpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ, kālaggahaṇa.mihānuvattate, tena paccuppanne kāle vattamānavibhattiyohontītyattho. Etthacakālonāmakāro, kāronāma kriyā, tatthāhi kāloti karakaraṇetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa karaṇaṃ kārotyatte visarujapadāditoṇaityānuvattamāne bhāvece
[p. 322]
ti ṇapaccayaṃkatvā kāritiviya ṇānubandhoti kāritamivakatvākāritānaṃ ṇolopanti ṇalopaṃ katvā asaṃyogantassa vuddhikāritetikakāre akārassavuddhiṃ katvā dodhassaceti ettha caggahaṇena rakārassa lakārādese kate rūpaṃ, tasmā paccuppanna kriyāyagamyamānāya vattamānavibhattiyohontītyattovagantabbo. Etthaca kālassātītānāgata paccuppannā-ṇatti parikappakālāti pattivasena chadhā bhinnattāpaccuppanneti viseseti. Tatthacātīto tividho atītāparokkhāatītahiyyattanī atīta ajjattanīti. Tecuttariyevāvibhavissanti. Kriyāvācakāhi āchātā. Kriyāpana sesatumhāmhasaṅkhātasādhakappaṭibaddhā. Imesañcapana kriyāvācakatākiṃ karosīti vuṭṭhassapacāmītyādinā āchātenapaṭivaca-nadānatoca, pacati paṭhatītyādināchātena yogatoca, pācakopacatyādinā-chātassa sādhanenayogatocaveditabbo.

**Ya tikālaṃ tipurisaṃ, kriyāvāci, ti kārataṃ.**

**Atiliṅgaṃ dvivacanaṃ, tadāchātanti vuccati.**

Taṃpanāchātaṃvattamānikādvādasa, pañcamiyodvādasa, sattamiyodvādasa, parokk-hāyodvādasa, hiyyattaniyodvādasa, ajjataniyodvādasa, bhavissantiyodvādasa, kālātipattiyo dvādasātichannavutividhaṃhoti. *Gacchati* pavisatītyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca gacchatītiheṭṭhā vuttameva. Pavisatītipapubbassavisa pavesanetimassa laddha dhātu saññādissa aneka paccayappasaṅge vuttanayena vattamāna saññādiṃkatvā iminā tipaccayaṃ katvā bhūvāditoaityapaccayaṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ.

415.ru:
**451\. Āṇaty-āsiṭṭhe ‘nuttakāle pañcamī** (880) \[VI 10\].

	Āṇatyatthe ca āsīsatthe ca anuttakāle **pañcamī**vibhatti hoti.

	Sati pi kālādhikāre puna **kāla**ggahaṇena **vidhi-nimantanājjhesanānumati-patthanā-pattakālā**dīsu ca pañcamī. Āṇāpanam **āṇatti**, āsīsanam **asiṭṭho**, so ca iṭṭhassa asampattassa atthassa patthanaṃ, tasmiṃ **āṇaty-āsiṭṭhe**. Anu samīpe uttakālo **anuttakālo**, paccuppannakālo ti attho, na uttakālo ti vā anuttakālo, tasmiṃ anuttakāle, kālam anāmasitvā hotī ti attho.

	Tattha **āsīsanatthe** **bhū**dhātuto pañcamīparassapadapaṭhamapuris’-ekavacanaṃ **tu**, **a**ppaccaya-vuddhi-**avā**desā. So sukhī bhavatu, te sukhitā bhavantu.

	Vipariṇamena “akārato” ti vattate.
415.nyasa:
(415) **Āṇatyā siṭṭhenuttakāle pañcamī** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, āṇatyattheca āsisattheca anuttakāle pañcamīvibhattiyo hontītiñāpanatthaṃ, tipadamidaṃ, kālagga-haṇamihānuvattate. Etthaca āṇattī tyāṇāpanaṃ. Āsisaṭṭhotipasaṃsā. Anuttakāloti samīpevutta-kālo. Āsisaṭṭhotipasaṃsā. Anusaddohi samīpatthavācī, tasmāāṇāpana-ttheca pasaṃsattheca gamyamāne paccupannekāle pañcamīvibhattiyo

page323

hontīti tyattho. Imasmiṃpana pakkhe āṇātyādīnaṃ vattamanatthe satipi āṇāpanādi-guṇa visiṭṭhattā punaggahaṇaṃ katanti veditabbaṃ. Uttokāloyassaso uttakālo. Nauttakā-loanuttakālo, tasmiṃ anuttakāle, evaṃsati anuttakāle āṇāpanattheca pasaṃsattheca pañcamīvibhattiyohontītyattho, kālamanāmasitvā āṇāttiyaṃ pasaṃsattheca pañcamīvibhattiyo hontīti vuttaṃ hoti, idhapanapubbapakkhavacena vinicchayovaga-ntabbo. *Karotukusalaṃ, sukhaṃte *hotūtyudāharaṇāni. Tatthaca karotūtikarakaraṇetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissakusalaṃ karotūtyattheāṇāpanattha sambhavato pañcamītuantu hithamimataṃantaṃ suvho eāmasetitvādīnaṃpañcamī-saññaṃkatvāimināpañcamiyokatvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge vatti. Pa . Katvā atha-pubbānivibhattīnaṃ chaparassapadānīti pañcamīvibhattīnaṃ pubbāsaṃchannaṃ para-ssapadasaññaṃ katvā kattariparassapadantiparassapadasaññaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyama-ppasaṅgevatti. Pa . Katvā dvedvepaṭhama majjhimuttamapurisāti ādimhi dvinnaṃ paṭhamapurisasaññaṃ katvā nāmamhipayujjamānepi tulyādhikaraṇepaṭhamoti paṭhamapurisaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vatti. Pa. Katvā ekamhivattabbe ekavacanantiekavacana tuvibhattiṃ katvā tanādito oyirāti dhātumhā opaccaye kate netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Hotūti hūsattāyamitimassaladdhadhātusaññā dissa sukhaṃtehotūtyatthe āsisatthassasambhavato vuttanayena tvādīnaṃ pañcamīsaññā-diṃ katvā iminātuvibhattimhikate asaṃyogantassa vuddhikāritetivattamāne aññesucā-tivuddhiṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge ayuvaṇṇānañcāyovuddhīti ukārassokāraṃ-katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ.

416.ru:
**454\. Anumati-parikappatthesu sattamī** (881, 883-4) \[VI 8\].

	Anumatyatthe ca parikappatthe ca anuttakāle **sattamī**vihatti hoti.

	**Attha**ggahaṇena **vidhi-nimantanā**dīsu ca sattamī.[^22] Kattum icchato parassa anujānanaṃ **anumati**, parikappanaṃ **parikappo**, “yadi nāma bhaveyyā” ti sallakkhaṇaṃ nirūpanaṃ, hetu kriyāya sambhave phalakriyāya sambhavaparikappo ca.

	Tattha **parikappe** sattamīparassapadapaṭhamapuris’-ekavacanaṃ **eyya**, **a**ppaccaya-vuddhādi purimasamaṃ, “kvaci dhātu vibhattī” ti ādinā eyya eyyāsi eyyāmi eyyaṃ icc etesaṃ vikappena **e**kārādeso.[^23] So dāni kiṃ nu kho bhave. Yadi so paṭhamavaye pabbajeyya, arahā bhaveyya. Sace saṅkhārā niccā bhaveyyuṃ, na nirujjeyyuṃ. Yadi tvaṃ bhaveyyāsi. Tumhe bhaveyyātha. Katham ahaṃ devo bhaveyyāmi. Kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ bhaveyyāma. Tathā bhavetha, bhaveraṃ; bhavetho, bhaveyyāvho.

	**Patthane** tu ahaṃ sukhī bhave, Buddho bhaveyyaṃ, bhaveyyāmhe.

	**Kammani** sukhaṃ tayā anubhūyetha, anubhūyeraṃ; anubhūyetho, anubhūyeyyāvho; anubhūye, anubhūyeyyaṃ, anubhūyeyyāmhe. **Parassapadatte** anubhūyeyya, anubhūyeyyuṃ; anubhūyeyyāsi icc ādi. **Bhāve** bhūyetha.

	**Vidhimhi** so odanaṃ pace, paceyya, paceyyuṃ; tvaṃ pace, paceyyāsi, tumhe paceyyātha; ahaṃ pace, paceyyāmi, mayaṃ paceyyāma. Pacetha, paceraṃ; pacetho, paceyyāvho; pace, paceyyaṃ, paceyyāmhe.

	**Kammani** paccetha, pacceraṃ; paccetho, pacceyyāvho; pacce, pacceyyaṃ, pacceyyāmhe. **Parassapadatte** pacce, pacceyya, pacceyyuṃ; pacceyyāsi icc ādi.

	**Anumatiyaṃ** so gāmaṃ gacche, gaccheyya, “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā **eyyu**ssa **uṃ** vā,[^24] gacchuṃ, gaccheyyuṃ. Tvaṃ gacche, gaccheyyāsi, gaccheyyātha; gacche, gaccheyyāmi, gaccheyyāma. Game, gameyya; gamuṃ, gameyyuṃ; game, gameyyāsi, gameyyātha; game, gameyyāmi, gameyyāma. Gacchetha, gaccheraṃ; gacchetho, gaccheyyāvho; gacche, gaccheyyaṃ, gaccheyyāmhe; gametha, gameraṃ icc ādi.

	**Kammani** gacchīyetha, gamīyetha; gacchīyeraṃ, gamīyeraṃ icc ādi. **Parassapadatte** gacchīyeyya, gamīyeyya, gammeyya; gammeyyuṃ icc ādi. Tathā ghamme, ghammeyya; ghammeyyuṃ icc ādi.

Sattamīvibhatti.

Paccuppannāṇatti-parikappakālikavibhattinayo.
416.nyasa:
(416) **Anumati Parikappatthesu Sattamī** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, anumatyattheca parikappattheca anuttakāle sattamīvibhattiyohontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Anuttakālaggahaṇami hānuvattate. Attho suviññeyyova. Idhacaanumatiyeva attho anumatyattho, tasmiṃ anumatyatthe, anumaticakhoparassa anumati. Parikappoye-vatthoparikappattho, tasmiṃ parikappatthe, parikappocakho attanoparikappe
[p. 324]
tvaṃ *gaccheyāsi, kimahaṃ *kareyyāmītyudāharaṇāni, tatthacagaccheyyāsītigamusa-ppagatimhītimassaladdhadhātusaññādissa devadatta kiṃ tvaṃgaccheyyāsītyattheanu-matyatthasambhavato sattamī eyyaeyyuṃeyyāsieyyāthaeyyāmieyyāmaetha era etho eyyāvho eyyaṃ eyyāmheti eyyādīnaṃsattamīsaññaṃkatvā anantarasuttamadhikicci-minā sattamiyo katvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge sativatticchānupubbikāsaddappa-ṭipattīkatvā heṭṭhāvuttanayenādimhi channaṃparassapadasaññaṃkatvā kattariparassa-padanti parassapadaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayena majjhimapurisa-saññaṃ katvā nāmamhi payujjamānepi tulyādhikaraṇepaṭhamotivattamāne tumhemajjhimotimajjhimapurisaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayena ekavacaneyyāsivibhattiṃ katvā gamissantocchovā sabbāsūti dhātvaṅtassacchādesaṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Kareyyāmītikara karaṇetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa kiṃnukho ahamidāni kareyyāmītyatthe parikappattha sambhavato vuttanayeniminā sattamiyo katvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅgevuttanayena parassapadasaññaṃ katvā kattariparassapadanti parassapadavibhattiṃ katvā tassāpya niyamappasaṅge vuttanayenuttamapurisasaññaṃ katvā nāmamhi payujjamānepi tulyādhikaraṇe paṭhamotivattamāne amheuttamoti uttamapurisaṃ katvā tassapyaniya-mappasaṅge vuttanayena ekavacaneyyāmivibhattiṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ.

417.ru:
**460\. Apaccakkhe parokkhātīte** (885) \[VI 6\].

Apaccakkhe vattuno indriyāvisayabhūte atīte kāle **parokkhā**vibhatti hoti. Atikkamma ito ti **atīto**, hutvā atikkanto ti attho.

Heṭṭhā vuttanayena parokkhā-parassapada-paṭhamapuris’-ekavacanaṃ **a**. “Bhū \+ a” itīdha.

Vipariṇāmena “dhātūnan” ti vattate.
417.nyasa:
(417) **Apaccakkheparokkhātīte** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, apaccakkhe atīte kāleparokkhā vibhattiyo hontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ. Kālaggahaṇamihānu-vattate. Atthocaviggahoca suviññeyyova. Supinekilamāha evaṃkilaporāṇāhūtyudāha-raṇāni, tattha ca *āhātibrūviyattiyaṃ vācāyamitimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa supinekilabravītyatthe apaccakkhetītatthassa sambhavato parokkhāau ettha aṃmhattharetthovhoiṃmheti auādīnaṃparokkhāsaññaṃ katvā kāletyanuvattamane imināparokkhāvibhattiyo katvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenaādimhi channaṃ vuttanayenaparassa padasaññaṃ-katvā kattariparassapadanti parassapadaṃ katvā tassāpyani
[p. 325]
yamappasaṅge vuttanayena paṭhamapurisasaññaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge nāmamhipayujjamānepi tulyādhikaraṇe paṭhamotipaṭhamapurisaṃkatvā tassāpyaniya-mappasaṅge vuttanayena ekavacanaavibhattiṃ katvā brūbhūnamāhabhūvā parokkhāyanti sabbasseva brūdhātussaāhādesaṃkatvā saralopomādesapaccayādimhi saralopetupakatīti-saralopapakatibhāvañca katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. Itarasmiṃ bahuvacanauvibhattikaraṇamevaviseso.

418.ru:
**456\. Hiyyopabhuti paccakkhe hiyyattanī** (886) \[VI 5\].

Hiyyopabhuti atīte kāle paccakkhe vā appaccakkhe vā **hiyyattanī**vibhatti hotī ti hiyyattanīparassapadapaṭhamapuris’-ekavacanaṃ **ā**.

“Kvaci dhātu” icc ādito “kvaci,” “dhātūnan” ti ca vattate.
418.nyasa: (418) **Hiyyopatuti Paccakkhe Hiyyattanī** : : Kimatthanisaṃ, hiyyopatuti atītekālepaccakkhevā apaccakkhevā hiyyattanī vibhattiyohontītiñāpanatthaṃ. Tipada-midaṃ. Kālaggahaṇañca apaccakkhaggahaṇañcaatītaggahaṇañca vattate. Atthoca-viggahoca suviññeyyova, soagamāmaggaṃ, teagamūmaggantyu dāharaṇāni, tatthaca *agamātigamusappagatimhītimassa laddhadhātu saññādissa soagaṃmātyatthe hiyya-ttanīāū ottha aṃmhātthatthuṃsevhaṃ iṃmhasetiā ādīnaṃ hiyyattanīsaññaṃkatvā kāle apaccakkhe parokkhātīteti vattamāne imināhiyyattanīvibhattiyo katvā tāsaṃpyani-yamappasaṅge vuttanayenādimhi channaṃparassa padasaññaṃ katvā kattaripara-ssapadanti parassapadaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅgevuttanayena paṭhamapurisa-saññaṃ katvā nāmamhi payujjamānepi tulyādhikaraṇe paṭhamoti paṭhama purisasaññaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅgevuttanayenaekavacana āvibhattiṃ katvā kvacidhātuvibhatti paccayānaṃ dīghaviparītādesalopāgamācetivattamāneakārāga-mohiyyattanajjatanīkālātipattīsūtidhātvādimhi ākārāgamaṃ katvā netabbenīterūpaṃ. Itarasmiṃ bahuvacanaūvibhattikaraṇamevaviseso.

419.ru:
**469\. Samīpe ‘jjatanī** (887) \[VI 4\].

**Samīpe** samīpato paṭhāya ajjappabhuti atīte kāle paccakkhe ca apaccakkhe ca **ajjatanī**vibhatti hotī ti ajjatanī-parassapada-paṭhamapuris’-ekavacanaṃ **ī**.

Pure viya **a**kārāgamo, vuddhādi ca, “kvaci dhātuvibhattī” ti ādinā **ī-mhā**divibhattīnaṃ kvaci rassattaṃ,[^37] **o-ā-a**vacanānaṃ **i-ttha-am**ādeso ca,[^38] saralopādi. So abhavi, abhavī vā; **ā**kārāgamābhāve bhavi.

Maṇḍūkagatiyā “vā” ti vattate.
419.nyasa:
(419) **Samīpejjatanī** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, samīpe atīte kālepaccakkhevā-apacca kkhevāajjatanīvibhattiyohontītiñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Kālaggahaṇañca apaccaggahaṇañca atītaggahaṇañca paccakkhaggahaṇañca vattate. Atthoca viggahoca suviññeyyova. Somaggaagamī, temaggaṃagamuntyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca * agamītiga-musappagati mhītimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa so agamītyatthe ajjatanī īuṃ
[p. 326]
otthaimhā āūsevhaṃaṃmheti īādīnaṃ ajjatanīsaññaṃkatvā kāle apaccakkhe parokkhātīte hiyyopabhūti paccakkhehiyyattanī tyadhikicciminā ajjatanī vibhattiyo katvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge sativuttanayenādimhi channaṃparassapadasaññaṃ-katvā kattariparassapadantiparassapadaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttana-yena paṭhamapurisasaññaṃkatvā nāmamhipayujjamānepitulyādhikaraṇepaṭhamoti-paṭhamapurisaṃkatvā tassā-pyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenekavacana īvibhattiṃ katvā vuttanayena dhātvādimhi akārāgamaṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ, itarasmiṃ bahuvacanauṃvibhattikaraṇameva-viseso.

420.ru:
**471\. Māyoge sabbakāle ca** (888) \[VI 13\].

Yadā **mā**yogo, tadā **hiyyattan’-ajjatanī**vibhattiyo sabbakāle pi honti, **ca**saddena **pañcamī** ca.[^47] Mā bhavati, mā bhavā, mā bhavissatī ti vā[^48] atthe hiyyattan’-ajjatanī-pañcamīvibhattiyo, sesaṃ neyyaṃ. So mā bhavā, mā bhavī; mā te bhavantv antarāyā.[^49] Mā pacā, mā pacī, mā pacatu. Mā gacchā, mā gacchī, mā gacchatu. Mā kañci pāpam āgamā,[^50] mā agami, mā gamā, mā gamī, mā gametu. Tvaṃ mā gaccho, mā gacchi, mā gacchāhi icc ādi.

Atītakālikavibhatti.
420.nyasa: (420) **Māyoge Sabbakāleca** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, yadā māyoge tadāhiyyatta-nīajjatanīvibhattiyo sabbakālepihontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ hiyyattaniggaha-ṇañca ajjataniggahaṇañcavattate. Casaddaggahaṇappayojanaṃ sayamevavakkhati. Attho suviññeyyo vaviggahoca. Māgamā, māvacā, māgamī, māvacītyudāharaṇāni, tatthacamā *gamātimāsaddūpapadassa gamusappagatimhītimassa laddhadhātusaññā-disā māgamīmā-gacchatimāgacchissasi māgacchaissātyatthe vuttanayena ā ādīnaṃ hiyyattanīsaññādiṃ katvā hiyyopabhutipaccakkhehiyyattanī samīpejjatanītyadhikicci-mināvibhattādimhi katerūpaṃ. Itarasmiṃ vacaviyattiyaṃvācāyamitidhātumattameva-nānattaṃ. *Māgamīti tasse-vadhātussatasmiṃ yevatthe īādīnaṃ ajjatanisaññaṃ katvā vuttanayena iminā īpaccayādimhi kate rūpaṃ. Itarasmiṃ dhātumattamevaviseso. Mā *gacchāhīticaggahaṇaphalaṃ, taṃpanamāsaddūpadassagamusappagatimhītimassa mā-gacchatimāgamīmāgacchissatimāgacchi-ssātyatthe vuttanayena tvādīnaṃ pañcamīsa-ññaṃkatvā idhacaggahaṇenapañcamīhivibhattiṃ katvā bhūvādito aityapaccayaṃ katvā gamissantocchovāsabbāsūti dhātvantassacchīdesaṃ katvā akārodīghaṃ himimesūtiākārassadīghe kate rūpaṃ.

421.ru:
**473\. Anāgate bhavissantī** (892) \[VI 2\].

	Anāgate kāle **bhavissantī**vibhatti hoti.

		Atīte pi **bhavissantī**, taṃkālavacanicchayā;[^52]  
		“Anekajāti saṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissan”[^53] ti ādisu.

Na āgato **anāgato**, paccayasāmaggiyaṃ sati āyatiṃ uppajjanāraho ti attho. **I**kārāgamo, vuddhi-**avā**desā, saralopādi ca.

Bhavissati, bhavissanti; bhavissasi, bhavissatha; bhavissāmi, bhavissāma. Bhavissate, bhavissante; bhavissase, bhavissavhe; bhavissaṃ, bhavissāmhe.

**Kamme** **ya**ppaccayalopo, sukhaṃ tayā anubhavissate, anubhavissante; anubhavissase, anubhavissavhe; anubhavissaṃ, anubhavissāmhe. **Parassapadatte** anubhavissati Devadattena, anubhavissanti icc ādi. **Bhāve** bhavissate tena, **ya**ppaccayalopābhāve anubhūyissate, anubhūyissante icc ādi. **Bhāve** bhūyissate.

Tathā pacissati, pacissanti; pacissasi, pacissatha; pacissāmi, pacissāma. Pacissate, pacissante; pacissase, pacissavhe; pacissaṃ, pacissāmhe.

**Kamme** paccissate odano Devadattena, paccissante icc ādi. **Parassapadatte** paccissati, paccissanti; paccissasi, paccissatha; paccissāmi, paccissāma.

Gacchissati, gacchissanti; gacchissasi, gacchissatha; gacchissāmi, gacchissāma. Gacchissate, gacchissante; gacchissase, gacchissavhe; gacchissaṃ, gacchissāmhe. So saggaṃ gamissati, gamissanti; gamissasi, gamissatha; gamissāmi, gamissāma icc ādi.

**Kamme** gacchīyissate, gacchīyissante; gacchīyissati, gacchīyissanti vā. Gamīyissate, gamīyissante. Gamīyissati, gamīyissanti vā icc ādi. **Ya**ppaccayalope gamissate, gamissante; gamissati, gamissanti vā. Tathā ghammissati, ghammissanti icc ādi.

Bhavissantīvibhatti.
421.nyasa:
(421) **Anāgate Bhavissanti** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, anāgatekālebhavissanti-vibhattiyo hontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Kālaggahaṇamihānuvattate. Attho suviññeyyova viggahoca.
[p. 327]
Sogacchissati karissati, tegacchissanti, karissantītyudāharaṇāni. Tatthaca *gacchissa-tīti gamusappagatimhītimassa laddhadhātu saññādissa bhavissantissatissanti ssasi-ssatha ssāmissāma ssatessantessasessāvhesaṃsāmhetissatyādīnaṃ bhavissantisaññaṃ katvā kāletivattamāne iminābhavissantipaccaye katvā tesaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenādimhi channaṃparassapadasaññaṃ katvā kattariparassapadantiparassa-padaṃ katvā tassā pyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayena paṭhamapurisasaññaṃkatvā nāmamhiparujjamānepitulyādhikaraṇepaṭhamotipaṭhamapurisaṃ katvā tassāpyaniya-mappasaṅge vuttanayeneka vacanaṃ katvā gamissantocchovā sabbāsūti dhātva-ntassacchādesaṃ katvāhiyyattanīsattamīpañcamīvattamānāsabbadhātukanti vuttattā nasabbadhātukaṃ asabbadhātukanti asabbadhātukattamāgamma ikārāgamo asabbadhātukamhīti ikārāgamaṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Karissatīti ettha kara karaṇetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa vuttanayena ssatipaccayādimhi kate rūpaṃ, cchādesābhāvova viseso. Sesaṃheṭṭhāvuttanayameva. Itaresudvīsu bahuvacanassanti vibhatti karaṇamevaviseso.

422.ru:
**475\. Kriyātipanne ‘tīte kālātipatti** (895) \[VI 7\]

Kriyātipannamatte atīte kāle **kālātipatti**vibhatti hoti. Kriyāya atipatanaṃ **kriyātipannaṃ**, taṃ pana sādhakasattivirahena kriyāya accantānuppatti. Ettha ca kiñcāpi na kriyā atītasaddena voharitabbā, tathā pi takkiriyuppattippaṭibandhakarakriyāya kālabhedena atītavohāro labbhate vā ti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

Kālātipatti-parassapada-paṭhamapuris’-ekavacanaṃ **ssā**, **a**kār’-**i**kārāgamā, vuddhi-**avā**desā ca,[^56] “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā **ssā-ssāmhā**vibhattīnaṃ kvaci rassattaṃ, **sse**vacanassa ca **a**ttaṃ.[^57]

So ce paṭhamavaye pabbajjaṃ alabhissa, arahā abhavissa, bhavissa, abhavissā, bhavissā vā; te ce taṃ alabhissaṃsu, arahanto abhavissaṃsu, bhavissaṃsu. Evaṃ tvaṃ abhavissa, bhavissa, abhavisse vā; tumhe abhavissatha, bhavissatha. Ahaṃ abhavissaṃ, bhavissaṃ; mayaṃ abhavissāmha, bhavissāmha, abhavissāmhā, bhavissāmhā vā. So abhavissatha, abhavissisu; abhavissase, abhavissavhe; abhavissiṃ, abhavissāmhase.

**Kamme** anvabhavissatha, anvabhavissisu; anvabhūyissatha vā icc ādi. **Parassapadatte** anvabhavissa, anvabhavissaṃsu; anvabhūyissa vā icc ādi. **Bhāve** abhavissatha Devadattena, abhūyissatha.

Tathā so ce taṃ dhanaṃ alabhissa, odanaṃ apacissa, pacissa, apacissā, pacissā vā; apacissaṃsu, pacissaṃsu; apacissa, pacissa, apacisse, pacisse vā; apacissatha, pacissatha; apacissaṃ, pacissaṃ; apacissāmha, pacissāmha, apacissāmhā, pacissāmhā vā. Apacissatha, pacissatha, apacissisu, pacissisu; apacissase, pacissase; apacissavhe, pacissavhe; apacissiṃ, pacissiṃ; apacissāmhase, pacissāmhase.

**Kamme** apacissatha odano Devadattena, apacissisu. **Ya**ppaccayalopābhāve apacīyissatha icc ādi. **Parassapadatte** apaccissa tena, paccissa, apaccissā, paccissā vā; apaccissaṃsu, paccissaṃsu icc ādi.

So agacchissa, gacchissa, agacchissā, gacchissā vā; agacchissaṃsu, gacchissaṃsu. Tvaṃ agacchissa, gacchissa, agacchisse, gacchisse vā; agacchissatha, gacchissatha; agacchissaṃ, gacchissaṃ, agacchissāmha, gacchissāmha, agacchissāmhā, gacchissāmhā vā. Agamissa, gamissa, agamissā, gamissā vā; agamissaṃsu, gamissaṃsu. Agamissa, gamissa, agamisse vā; agamissatha, gamissatha; agamissaṃ, gamissaṃ, agamissāmha, gamissāmha, agamissāmhā, gamissāmhā vā. Agacchissatha, gacchissatha vā icc ādi.

**Kamme** agacchīyissatha, agamīyissatha, agacchīyissa, agamīyissa icc ādi. Tathā aghammissā, aghammissaṃsu icc ādi.

Kālātipattivibhatti.

			Pañcamī sattamī vatta-mānā sampati ’nāgate;  
			Bhavissantī parokkhādi, catasso ‘tītakālikā.

Chakālikavibhattividhānaṃ.

**Vikaraṇavidhāna**

	**Isu** icchā-kantīsu, pure viya dhātvantalopo, **ty**ādyuppatti, **a**ppaccayo ca.

	“Dhātūnan” ti vattamāne.
422.nyasa:
(422) **Kriyātipanne Tīte Kālātipatti** : : Kimatthamidaṃ kriyātipannamatte atīte kāle kālātipatti vibhattiyohontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ. Kālaggahaṇami-hānuvattate. Atthosuviññeyyova. Atipatanaṃatipannaṃ, kriyāyātipannaṃ kriyātipa-nnaṃ taṃpana sādhakasattivirahena kriyāyāccantayuppatti, ta smiṃkriyātopanne, etthacakiñcāvi nakriyātītasaddena voharitabbā, tathāpi takriyuppattippaṭiladdha-karaṇakattukriyāya kālabhedena atītavohāro labbhatevetidaṭṭhabbaṃ. Socetaṃ yānaṃ alabhissāagacchissā, tecetaṃyānaṃ alabhissaṃsuagacchissaṃ sūtyudāha raṇāni. Tatthaca *alabhissāti labhalābhetimassa laddhadhātu saññādissa socetaṃ yānamalabhissātyatthe kālātipattissāssaṃsussessatha ssaṃssāmhāssathassisussasessa vhessiṃ ssāmhasetissādīnaṃkālātipattisaññaṃ katvā kāle
[p. 328]
Tivattamāne iminā kālātipattivibhattiyo katvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge sativutta-nayenādimhi channaṃparassapadasannaṃkatvā kattariparassapadantiparassapadaṃ-katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅgevuttanayena paṭhamapurisasaññaṃ katvā nāmamhipa-rujjamānepitulyādhikaraṇepaṭhamotipaṭhamapurisaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenekavacanassāvibhattiṃ katvā heṭṭhā vuttanayena asabbadhātukattamāga-mmaikārāgamoiasa bbadhātukamhītidhātumhā ikārāgamaṃ katvā vuttanayena akārāgamo hiyyattanī ajjatanīkālātipattīsūti ādimhi akārāgamaṃkatvā netabbe nīterūpaṃ. Itaraṃpanagamusappagatimhītimassa vuttanayenassāpaccayādimhi kate rūpaṃ, cchādeso vaviseso. Itaresudvīsu bahuvacanassaṃsuvibhattikaraṇamevaviseso.

423.pali: Vattamānā ti anti, si tha, mi ma; te ante, se vhe, e mhe
423.ru:
**426\. Vattamānā ti anti, si tha, mi ma; te ante, se vhe, e mhe** (896) \[VI 1\].

**Ty**ādayo dvādasa vattamānāsaññā hontī ti **ty**ādīnaṃ vattamānatthavisayattā **vattamānā**saññā.
423.nyasa: (423) **Vattamānāti, anti, si, tha, mi, ma, te, ante, se, vhe, e, mhe** : : Kima-tthamidaṃ, tyādayovattamānasaññā hontītiñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ, atthocavi-ggahoca suviññeyyova. Bhavati, bhavanti, bhavasi, bhavatha, bhavāmi, bhavāma, bhavate, bhavante, bhavase, bhavavhe, bhave, bhavāmhetyādīnimassavisayāni. Tatthaca *bhavatītisū sattāyamitimassaladdhadhātusaññādissānekapaccayappasa-ṅgetyādīniiminā vattamānasaññaṃkatvā vuttanayena vattamānapaccayekatvā tesaṃ-pyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenādimhi channaṃparassapadasaññaṃkatvā kattaripara-ssapadantiparassapadaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenādimhi dvinnaṃ-paṭhamapurisasaññaṃkatvā nāmamhiparujjamānepi tulyādhikaraṇe paṭhamoti paṭha-mapurisaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge sati vuttanayena ekavacanativibhattiṃ katvā bhūvādito aityapaccayaṃ katvā asaṃyogantassa vuddhikāritetivattamāne aññesucātidhātvantassa vuddhiṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge ayuvaṇṇānañcayo-vuddhītiūkārassokāraṃ katvā oavasareti okārassa avādesṃkatvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. Itarāninayā nuyogena suviññe-yyāneva.

424.pali: Pañcamī tu antu, hi tha, mi ma; taṃ antaṃ, ssu vho, e āmase
424.ru:
**450\. Pañcamī tu antu, hi tha, mi ma; taṃ antaṃ, ssu vho, e āmase** (897) \[VI 10\].

	**Tv**ādayo dvādasa **pañcamī**saññā honti.
424.nyasa:
(424) **Pañcamītu, antu hi, thami ma, taṃ, antaṃ, su, vho, e, āmase** : : Kimattha-midaṃm tvādayo pañcamīsaññāhontīti ñāpanatthaṃ.
[p. 329]
**6-Ākhyātta- Paṭhamakaṇḍa**

dvipadamidaṃ. Atthocaviggahoca suviññeyyova. Bhavatu, bhavantu, bhavāhi, bhavatha, bhavāmi, bhavāma, bhavataṃ, bhavantaṃ, bhavassu, bhavavho, bhave, bhavāmasetyādīnimassavisayāni. Tānisuviññeyyāneva.

425.pali: Sattamī eyya eyyuṃ, eyyāsi eyyātha, eyyāmi eyyāma; etha eraṃ, etho eyyāvho, eyyaṃ eyyāmhe
425.ru:
**453\. Sattamī eyya eyyuṃ, eyyāsi eyyātha, eyyāmi eyyāma; etha eraṃ, etho eyyāvho, eyyaṃ eyyāmhe** (898) \[IV 8\].

	**Eyyā**dayo dvādasa **sattamī**saññā honti. 

	“Anuttakāle” ti vattate.
425.nyasa: (425) **Sattamīeyya, eyyuṃ, eyyāsi, eyyātha, eyyāmi, eyyāma, etha, eraṃ, etho, eyyāvho, eyyaṃ, eyyāmhe** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, eyyādayo sattamīsaññāhontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Atthoca viggahocasu viññeyyova. Bhaveyya, bhave-yyuṃ, bhaveyyāsi, bhaveyyātha, bhaveyyāmi, bhaveyyāma, bhavetha, bhaveraṃ, bhavetho, bhaveyyāvho, bhaveyyaṃ, bhaveyyāmhetyādīnimassa visayāni. Tatthaca *bhaveyyātibhūiccetassiiminā eyyādīnaṃ sattamīsaññādiṃ katvā vuttanayena eyya-vibhattiṃkatvā vuttanayena bhūvādito aityapaccayaṃkatvā vuddhyavādesecakatvā saralopomādesapaccayādimhisaralopetu pakatītisaralopapakatibhāvādimhikate rūpaṃ. Itarāninayānuyo- gena suviññeyyāneva.

426.pali: Parokkhā a u, e ttha, aṃ mha; ttha re, ttho vho, iṃ mhe
426.ru:
**459\. Parokkhā a u, e ttha, aṃ mha; ttha re, tho vho, iṃ mhe** (899) \[VI 6\].[^28]

**Ā**\-ādayo dvādasa **parokkhā**saññā honti. Akkhānaṃ indriyānaṃ paraṃ parokkhā, taddīpakattā ayaṃ vibhatti **parokkhā** ti vuccati.
426.nyasa:
(426) **Parokkhā a, u, ettha, aṃ, mha, ttha, re, ttho, vho, iṃ, mhe** : : Ki-matthamidaṃ, aādayo parokkhāsaññhontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Atthocavi-ggahoca suviññeyyova. Babhūva, babhūvu, babhūve, babhūvittha, babhūva, babhūvimha, babhūvittha, babhūvire, babhūvittho, babhūvivho, babhūviṃ, babhū-vimhetyādīnimassa visayāni. Tatthaca *babhūvāti bhūsattāyamitimassa laddhadhā-tusaññādissaiminā aādīnaṃ parokkhāsaññaṃkatvāvuttanayena apaccakkheparokkhātī-tetiparokkhā ekavacana avibhattiṃkatvā kvacādi vaṇṇānamekasarānaṃ dvebhā-votidvebhāvaṃ katvā pubbobbhāsoti pubbassadhātussaabbhāsasaññaṃ katvā tame-vādhikiccadutiyacatutthānaṃ paṭhamatatiyāti catutthassa tatiyaṃkatvā pubbobbhāsoti vattamāne antassivaṇṇākārovāti abbhāsantassa akāraṃkatvā brūbhūnamāhabhūvā parokkhāyanti bhūdhātussabhūvādesṃkatvā saralopapa pakati bhāvādimhi kate rūpaṃ, itarānitaṃsadisāneva. Etthaikāro vuttanayena ikārāgamo asabbadhātuka mhītyāgato.
[p. 330]

427.pali: Hiyyattanī ā ū, o ttha, aṃ mhā; ttha tthuṃ, se vhaṃ, iṃ mhase
427.ru:
**455\. Hiyyattanī ā ū, o ttha, aṃ mhā[^25]; ttha tthuṃ, se vhaṃ, iṃ mhase** (900).

**Ā**\-ādayo dvādasa **hiyyattanī**saññā honti.

“Appaccakkhe,” “atīte” ti ca vattate.
427.nyasa: (427) **Hiyyattanī ā, ū, o, ttha, aṃ, mhā, ttha, tthuṃ, se, vhaṃ, iṃ, mha, se** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, aādayohiyyattanīsaññāhontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Attho-caviggahocasuviññeyyova. Abhavā, abhavū, abhavo, abhavattha, abhavaṃ, abhava-mhā, abhavattha, abhavatthuṃ, abhavase, abhavavhaṃ, abhaviṃ, abhavamhase-tyādīnimassavisayāni, tāni suviññeyyāneva.

428.pali: Ajjatanī ī uṃ, o ttha, iṃ mhā; ā ū, se vhaṃ, aṃ mhe
428.ru:
**468\. Ajjatanī ī uṃ, o ttha, iṃ mhā; ā ū, se vhaṃ, a mhe[^36]** (901) \[VI 4\].

**Ī**\-ādayo dvādasa **ajjatanī**saññā honti. Ajja bhavo ajjatano, taddīpakattā ayaṃ vibhatti **ajjatanī** ti vuccati.

“Apaccakkhe,” “atīte,” “paccakkhe” ti ca vattate.
428.nyasa: (428) **Ajjatanī ī, uṃ, o, ttha, iṃ, mhā, ā, ū, se, vhaṃ, aṃ, mhe** : : Kima-tthamidaṃ, īādayo ajjatanīsaññāhontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamida. Atthoca vigga-hoca suviññeyyova. Abhavī, abhavhaṃ, abhavo, abhavittha, abhaviṃ, abhavimhā, abhavā, abhavū, abhavise, abhavivhaṃ, abhavaṃ, abhavimhetyādīnimassavisayāni, tānisuviññeyyāneva, etthaca parassapada majjhimuttamapurisabahuvacananteca attanopadama jjhimuttamapurisa bahuvacananteca ikārāgamo asabbadhātukamhīti ikārāgamo.

429.pali: Bhavissantī ssati ssanti, ssasi ssatha, ssāmi ssāma; ssate ssante, ssase ssavhe, ssaṃ ssāmhe
429.ru:
**472\. Bhavissantī ssati ssanti, ssasi ssatha, ssāmi ssāma; ssate ssante, ssase ssavhe, ssaṃ ssāmhe** (902) \[VI 2\].

	**Ssaty**ādīnaṃ dvādasannaṃ vacanānaṃ **bhavissantī**saññā honti. Bhavissatī ti bhavissanto, taṃkāladīpakattā[^51] ayaṃ vibhatti **bhavissantī** ti vuccati.
429.nyasa: (429) **Bhavissantissati, ssanti, ssasi, ssatha, ssāmi, ssāma, ssate, ssante, ssase, ssavhe, ssaṃ, ssāmhe**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, ssatyadayobhavissantisaññāhontīti ñāpa-natthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ, atthoca viggahocasuviññeyyova. Bhavissati, bhavissanti, bhavissasi, bhavissatha, bhavissāmi, bhavissāma, bhavissate, bhavissante, bhavissase, bhavissavhe, bhavissaṃ, bhavissāmhetyādīnimassavisayāni, tānisuviññeyyāneva.

430.pali: Kālātipatti ssā ssaṃsu, sse ssatha, ssaṃ ssāmhā; ssatha ssisu, ssase ssavhe, ssiṃ ssāmhase
430.ru:
**474\. Kālātipatti ssā ssaṃsu, sse ssatha, ssaṃ ssāmhā; ssatha ssisu,[^54] ssase ssavhe, ssiṃ[^55] ssāmhase** (903) \[VI 7\].

**Ssā**dīnaṃ dvādasannaṃ **kālātipatti**saññā hoti. Kālassa atipatanaṃ kālātipatti, sā pana viruddhapaccayūpanipātato, kāraṇavekallato vā kriyāya anabhinibbatti, taddīpakattā ayaṃ vibhatti **kālātipattī** ti vuccati.
430.nyasa: (430) **Kālātipatti ssā, ssaṃsu, sse, ssatha, ssaṃ, ssāmhā, ssatha, ssisu, ssase, ssavhe, ssiṃ, ssāmhase**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, ssādayokālālipattisaññāhontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Atthoca, viggahoca suviññeyyova. Abhavissā, abha-vissaṃsu, abhavisse, abhavissatha abhavissaṃ abhavissāmhā abhavissatha abha-vissisu abhavissase abhavissavhe, abhavissiṃ, abhavissāmhasetyādīnimassavisayāni, tānisuviññeyyāneva.

431.ru:
**458\. Hiyyattanī-sattamī-pañcamī-vattamānā sabbadhātukaṃ** (904).

**Hiyyattanā**dayo catasso vibhattiyo **sabbadhātuka**saññā hontī ti hiyyattanādīnaṃ sabbadhātukasaññattā “ikārāgamo asabbadhātukamhī” ti vutto **i**kārāgamo na bhavati.

Sabbadhātukaṃ.
431.nyasa:
(431) **Hiyyattanī sattamīpañcamīvattamānā sabbadhātukaṃ** : : Kimatth-amidaṃ, hiyyattanādayo catasso sabbadhātuka saññāhontī
[p. 331]
tiñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Atthocaviggahocasuviññeyyova. *Agamātyādīnyudā-haraṇāni, tatthaca agamātigamusappagatimhītimassa heṭṭhāvuttanayenahiyyattanīpa-rassapadapaṭhamapurisaṃ katvā vuttanayenaakārāgamaṃkatvā imināsabbadhātuka-sasaññaṃkatvā sabbadhātukattā ikārāgamoasabbadhātukamhīti ikārāgamamhākate-rūpaṃ. Itarāninayānuyogenasuviññeyyāneva.

Samatto mukhamattadīpaniyaṃ ākhyātakappe paṭhamo paricchedo.

432.ru:
**362\. Dhātu-liṅgehi parā paccayā** (905).

	Dhātūhi, liṅgehi ca paccayā parā ’va hontī ti paribhāsato apaccatthasambandhiliṅgato[^2] chaṭṭhiyantā yeva paro hoti. Paṭicca etasmā attho etī ti **paccayo**, patīyanti anena atthā ti vā paccayo, “vuttatthānam appayogo” ti **apacca**saddassa appayogo, “tesaṃ vibhattiyo lopā ce” ti vibhattilopo ca.

	**363\. Tesaṃ ṇo lopaṃ** (834).

	Tesaṃ taddhitapaccayānaṃ **ṇā**nubandhānaṃ **ṇ**akāro lopam āpajjate.

	**364\. Vuddh’ ādisarassa vā ’saṃyogantassa saṇe ca** (834).

	Ādisarassa vā ādibyañjanassa vā asaṃyogantassa vuddhi hoti sa**ṇ**akārappaccaye pare. Saṃyogo anto assā ti saṃyoganto, tadañño **asaṃyoganto**. Atha vā vavatthitavibhāsattho ’yaṃ **vā**saddo, tadā ca pakatibhūte liṅge sarānam ādisarassa asaṃyogantassa vuddhi hoti sa**ṇ**akāre taddhitappaccaye pare ti attho.  
	Tena:

		Vāsiṭṭhādīsu niccā ’yaṃ, anicc’ oḷumpikādīsu[^3];  
		Na vuddhi nīlapītādo[^4], vavatthitavibhāsato.[^5]

	**Ca**saddaggahaṇam avadhāraṇatthaṃ.

	Tassā vuddhiyā aniyamappasaṅge niyamatthaṃ paribhāsam āha.

	**365\. A-y-uvaṇṇānañ c’ ā-y-o vuddhī** (864).

	Tesaṃ **a**kāra-**i**vaṇṇ’-**u**vaṇṇānam eva yathākkamaṃ **ā e o** icc ete vuddhiyo honti. **Ca**saddaggahaṇam avuddhisampiṇḍanatthaṃ, avadhāraṇatthaṃ vā. I ca u ca yu, yu eva vaṇṇā yuvaṇṇā, a ca yuvaṇṇā ca **a-y-uvaṇṇā**. Ā ca e ca o ca **āyo**. Puna **vuddhi**ggahaṇaṃ “negamajānapadā” ti ādīsu uttarapadavuddhibhāvatthaṃ, ettha ca “**a-y-u**vaṇṇānan” ti ṭhānaniyamavacanaṃ āyonaṃ vuddhibhāvappasaṅganivat
432.nyasa:
(432) **Dhatuliṅgehi Parā Paccayā** : : Kimatthamidaṃ dhātūhicaliṅgehica paccayāparāvahontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ, atthoca viggahoca suviññeyyova. Nanvimasmiṃ astipi tatthatattha dhātuyā kammādimhiṇo tatoca vibhattiyoti pañcamyantenaniiddiṭṭhattādhātu liṅgehipaccayāparāvahontīti sakkā viññātunti, nasakkā, tattha tatthacadūrantitaddhakālanimmāna tvālopadisāyoga vibhattārappayo-gasuddhappamocana hetuvivittappamāṇa pubbayogabandhanaguṇavacanapañhākatha-nathokākattūsuceti disāyoga vasena apādāna saññaṃkatvā apādāne pañcamīti pañcamiyākatattā dhātuliṅgehipubbeca paccayāhontī tyatthasambhavato, tasmā paccayaṭṭhānaniyama karaṇatthamidaṃ vuttaṃ. Idhāpidhātuliṅgehipaccayāti avatvā-paraggahaṇakaraṇaṃ tadatthamevadīpeti. Idaṃpanacatūsu suttesuparibhāsā suttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ, *karotītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthacakarotīti karakaraṇetimassa laddha-dhātusaññādissavuttanayena vattamānā paccuppanneti vattamānaparassapadapaṭhama-purisekavacana tivibhattiṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge iminā dhātuto paraṃkatvā tanādito oyirātiopaccayaṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Gacchatīti gamusa-ppagatimhītimassa vuttanayena tipaccayaṃ katvābhūvāditoaityapaccayaṃ katvā gamissantocchovāsabbāsūtidhātvantassacchādesaṃ katvā netabbenīterūpaṃ. *Kāretī-tikara karaṇetimassa yokocikaroti tamaññokarohi karotīti evaṃabravītyatthe karon-taṃpayojahatītyatthevā dhātūhiṇeṇaya ṇāpeṇāpaya
[p. 332]
Kāritānihetvattheti ṇepaccayaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge iminādhātuto parakatvā kāritānaṃṇolopanti ṇamhilutte asaṃyogantassa vuddhikāritetikakārā-ssasarassa vuddhiṃ katvā tatodhātupaccayehi vibhattiyoti vibhattiyokatvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge vutta-nayenatyādīnaṃ vattamānasaññaṃ katvā vattamānā paccuppanneti tipaccayekaterūpaṃ. *Pabbatāyatīti pabbatasaddato pabbatamivaattā-namācaratītyatthe āyanamato kattūpamānādā cāretiāyapaccayaṃkatvā tassāpyani-yamappasaṅge imināliṅgatoparakatvā saralopo mādesapaccayādimhi saralopetupakatī tisaralopapakatibhāvādiṃ katvātatodhātupaccayehivibhattiyotivibhattiyokatvā tāsaṃ-pyaniyamaooasaṅge vuttaniyena tipaccayekaterūpaṃ. *Vāsiṭṭhoti vasiṭṭhasaddatovasi-ṭṭhassāpaccantyatthe vāṇapaccetiṇapaccayaṃ katvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge iminā liṅgato paraṃ katvā vuttatthāna mappayogoti atthavākyamappayogaṃ katvā tesaṃ vibhattiyo lopācetiettha tesaṃ gahaṇena vibhattilopaṃ katvā vuddhādisarassavāsaṃ-yogantassasaṇeceti ādisarassavuddhiṃkatvā vuttanayenanā-mamivakatvātatoisyuppa-ttādimhikaterūpaṃ.

433.ru:
**528\. Tija-gupa-kita-mānehi kha-cha-sā vā** (906-9) \[V 1-3\].

	**Tija gupa kita māna** icc etehi dhātūhi **kha cha sa** icc ete paccayā parā honti vā.

		**Tija**to khantiyaṃ **kho** ‘va, nindāyaṃ  **gupa**to tu **cho**;  
		**Kitā** **cho** **so** ‘va **māna**mhā, vavatthitavibhāsato.

	“Kvac’ ādivaṇṇānam ekassarānaṃ dvebhāvo”[^182] ti dhātvādissa dvibhāvo.

	“Byañjanantassā”[^183] ti vattamāne.
433.nyasa:
(433) **Tijagupakitamānehikhachasāvā** : : Kimatthamida, tijagupakitamāna iccetehi dhātūhikhachasa iccetepaccayāhonti vikappenātiñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ. Atthoca viggahoca suviññeyyova. *Titikkhatītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthacatitikha-tītitija tejane. Tijanisānabandhana khamādīsūtidvinna maññatarassa laddhadhā-tusaññādissa iminākhapaccayaṃkatvā kvacādivaṇṇānamekasarānaṃ dvebhāvoti-dhātvādissadvibhāvaṃ katvā byañjanantassacochappaccayesucāti vattamāne kokhe-ceti dhātvantassa kādesaṃkatvā netabbaṃ netvā titikkhasaddato dhātupaccayehi vibhattiyoti vibhatyuppattimhi kate rūpaṃ. *Jigucchatīti gupagopanetimassa iminā tipaccayaṃkatvā vuttanayenādivaṇṇassadvibhāvaṃkatvā pubbo bbhāsotipubbassā-bbhā sasññakatvā tamevādhikicca antassivaṇṇākāropāti abbhā
[p. 333]
**6-Ākhyāta- Dutiyakaṇḍa**

santassa ikārādesaṃkatvā tamevādhikicca kavaggassa cavaggoti abbhāsassa kavaggassa cavaggakatvā byañjanantassacochappaccayesucāti dhātvantassacakā-raṃkatvā netabbaṃ netvā jigucchasaddato vuttanayenavibhatyuppattimhi kate rūpaṃ. *Tikicchatītikita rogāpanayanetimassa iminā chapaccayṃ katvā vuttanacyenā-divaṇṇassa dvibhāvaṃ katvā tassaca abbhāsasañña katvā pubbobbhāsoti vattamāne mānakitānaṃvatattaṃvāti abbhāsagatassakakārassatattaṃkatvā vuttanayenadhātvanta-ssa cakārakatvā netabbaṃ netvā tikicchasaddato vuttanayenavibhatyappattimhikate-rūpaṃ. *Vimaṃsatītimāna vīmaṃsā samitimassa imināsapaccayaṃkatvā vuttanayena dhātvādissadvibhāvaṃ katvā tassaabbhāsasaññakatvā vuttanayena antassivaṇṇākā-rovāti abbhāsantassīkāra katvā vuttanayena mānakitānaṃvatattaṃvāti abbhāsagatassa makārassa vakāraṃ katvā pubbobbhā sotivattamāne tatopāmānānaṃ vāmaṃsesūti abbhāsatoparassamāna iccetassamaṃ ādesaṃkatvā vīmaṃsasaddatoovuttanayena vibhatyuppattimhikaterūpaṃ. Itarāni vāggahaṇaṃphalāni, tatthacate jatītitija tejanetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa vāggahaṇenimi nākhapaccayamakatvāvuttanaye-navattamānāpaccuppannetitivibhacttiṃ katvā bhūvādito aityapaccayaṃkatvā asaṃyogantassa vuddhibhāriteti vattamāne aññesuceti ādisarassa vuddhiṃkatvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. Itaraṃ taṃsadisameva, dhātumattamevetthanānattiṃ. *Mānetītimāna vīmaṃsāyamitimassa vāggahaṇeniminā sapaccayamakatvā dhātūhi-ṇeṇayaṇāpeṇāpayakāritāni hetvattheti ṇepaccayaṃkattā vuttanayenaṇalopañcakatvā dhātupaccayehi vibhattiyoti vibhatyuppattimhikaterūpaṃ.

434.ru:
**534\. Bhuja-ghasa-hara-su-pādīhi tumicchatthesu[^191]** (910) \[V 4\].

	**Bhuja ghasa hara su pā** icc evamādīhi dhātūhi tumicchatthesu ca **kha cha sa** icc ete paccayā honti vā. Tum-icchānaṃ, tumantayutta-icchāya vā atthā **tumicchatthā**, tena tumantarahitesu “bhojanam icchatī” ti ādīsu na honti, “vuttatthānam appayogo” ti vākyassa appayogo, dhātvādissa dvebhāve kate “dutiya-catutthānaṃ paṭhama-tatiyā”[^192] ti abbhāsa-**bha**kārassa **ba**kāro, dhātvantassa “ko khe cā” ti **ka**kāro, bubhukkhati, bubhukkhanti icc ādi.

	**Vā** ti kimatthaṃ? Bhottum icchati, **icchatthesū** ti kimatthaṃ? Bhottuṃ gacchati.

	**Ghasa** adane, ghasitum icchatī ti atthe **cha**ppaccayo, dvittaṃ, tatiya-**ca**vagga-**i**kāra-**ca**kārādesā, jighacchati,[^193] jighacchanti.

	**Hara** haraṇe, haritum icchatī ti atthe **sa**ppaccayo.
434.nyasa:
(434)**Bhuja ghasa hara supādīhi tumicchatthesu**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, bhuja ghasaharasupā iccevamādīhi tumicchattesu gamyamānesu khachasaiccete paccayāhonti vikappenāti. ©āpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Khachasaggahaṇamihānu-vattate vāggahaṇañca. Attho suviññeyyova, tuṃcaicchācatumicchā. Tumicchā-naṃatthā tumicchatthā, tesu
[p. 334]
tumicchatthesu. Tumantenayuttāvāicchātumicchā, tumicchāyaatthātumicchatthā. Patt-hanākantā, tesutumicchatthesu. Nahitumantavirahitesu ghaṭakaraṇamicchati, paṭaka-raṇamicchatī tyadīsviminākhādayohontīti. *Bubhukkhatītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca bubhukkhatī tithuja pālanabyāharaṇe sūtimassa bhottumicchatītyatthe anantara suttamadhikicciminā khapaccayaṃ katvā vuttanayenādi vaṇṇassa dvibhāvaṃkatvā tassābbhāsasaññamkatvā pubbobbhāsotivattamānedutiyā catutthānaṃpaṭhamatatiyāti catutthassabhakārassatatiyaṃ bakāraṃkatvā dhātvantassa vuttanayena kokheceti kakāraṃkatvā netabbaṃnetvā bubhukkhasaddatovuttanayena vibhatyuppattimhi katerūpaṃ. *Jighacchatītighasa khādanetimassa ghasitumicchatītyatthe iminā chapa-ccayaṃkatvā vuttanayenādivaṇṇassadvibhāvaṃkatvā tassābbhāsasaññakatvā vuttana-yenakavaggassa cavaggoti abbhāsagatassakavaggassaghakārassa cavaggacakāraṃ-katvā tassadutiyacatutthānaṃ paṭhama tatiyātitatiyaṃkatvā antassivaṇṇākārovāti-abbhāsantassaivaṇṇaṃkatvā byañjanantassaco chappaccayesucāti dhātvantassacakā-raṃkatvā netabbaṃ netvā jighacchasaddato vuttanayena vibhatyuppattimhikaterūpaṃ. *Jigīsatītihara haraṇetimassa haritumicchatī tyatthe imināsapaccayaṃ katvā harassagīseti sabbadhātussagīādesaṃ katvā dhātvādesassa ṭhānopacāravasena dhātusaddena voharitabbato vuttanayenādivaṇṇassa dvibhāvaṃkatvā tassābbhāsasa-ññaṃkatvā vuttanayena kavaggassacavaggaṃkatvā jigīsasaddato vuttanayena vibhatyuppatti mhikaterūpaṃ. *Sussūsatītisusavanetimassa sotumicchatītyathe iminā sapaccayaṃkatvā vuttanayenādi vaṇṇassadvibhāvaṃkatvā majjhimassasakārassa paradvebhāvoṭhāneti dvibhāvaṃkatvā kvacidhātuvibhattipaccayānaṃ dīghaviparī-tādesalopāgamācetiparassukārassadīghaṃkatvāsussūsasaddato vuttanayenavibhatyu-ppattimhikate rūpaṃ. *Pivāsatītipā pānetimassa pātumicchatītyatthe imināsapacca-yaṃkatvā kvacādivaṇṇānameka sarānaṃdvebhāvotidvibhāvaṃkatvā tassapubbobbhā-sotiabbhāsasaññaṃkatvā
[p. 335]
**6-Āchāta-Dutiyakaṇḍa**

pubbobbhāsoti vattamāne antassi vaṇṇā kārivāti abbhāsantassa ikāraṃkatvā pubbobbhāsotivattamāne tatopāmā nānaṃvāmaṃsesūti abbhāsato parassapātussa vādesaṃkatvā pivāsasaddato vuttanayena vibhatyuppattimhikaterūpaṃ. *Bhottu-nti vāggahaṇaphalaṃ. Taṃpana bhujaiccetassa vāggahaṇeniminā khapaccayamakatvā icchetthesu samānakattukesu tavetuṃvātituṃ paccayaṃkatvā asaṃ yogantassa vuddhhi-kārite tyadhikicca aññesucāti ādisarassa vuddhiṃkatvā sāsadisato tassariṭṭhoceti vattamāne bhujādīnamantonodviceti dhātvantassa lopaṃkatvā takārassacadvibhāvaṃ-katvā netabbenīterūpaṃ. *Bhuñjatītikimudāharaṇaṃ, taṃpana tassodhātussa vuttanayena vattamānāpaccuppanneti vattamāna parassapadapaṭhama-purisekavacana tivibhattiṃkatvā bhūvādito aityanuvattamānerudhātito niggahītapu-bbañce tiapaccayañcakatvā pubbeniggahitāgamañcakatvā tassevavaggantaṃ vāvaggeti vaggantekaterūpaṃ.

435.ru:
**536\. Āya nāmato kattupamānā-d-ācāre** (911) \[V 8-10\].

	Ācaraṇakriyāya kattuno upamānabhūtamhā nāmato **āya**ppaccayo hoti ācāratthe. Upamīyati etenā ti upamānaṃ, kattuno upamānaṃ **kattupamānaṃ**, “vuttatthānam appayogo” ti **iva**saddanivatti, dhātuppaccayantattā “tesaṃ vibhattiyo lopā cā”[^199] ti sutte **tesaṃ**gahaṇena vibhattilopo, “pakati c’ assa sarantassā”[^200] ti pakatibhāvo, saralopādi, “dhātuppaccayehi vibhattiyo”[^201] ti vibhattuppatti, pabbatāyati saṃgho, evaṃ samuddam iva attānam ācarati samuddāyati, cicciṭam iva attānam ācarati cicciṭāyati[^202] saddo. Evaṃ dhūmāyati.[^203]

	“Nāmato,” “ācāre” ti ca vattate.
435.nyasa: (435) **Āya nāmato kattūpamānādācāre** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, kattuno upamā-nabhūbhamhānāmato āyapaccayohotiācārarrhetiñāpanatthaṃ. Pañcapadamidaṃ. Atthosuviññeyyova. Upameyyasaṅkhā tamatthaṃ upamīyati etenātyupamānaṃ, tasmāupamānā, nāmatoti minātulyādhikaraṇaṃ kattusaddo taṃniyamakaraṇatthaṃ vutto. *Pabbatāyatītyādīnyudāharaṇāni tatthaca pabbatāyatīti pabbatasaddatopabbata-mivaattānamācaratītyattheimināāpaccayaṃkatvā saralopāmādesapaccayādimhisaralo-petupakatītisaralopapakatibhāvādimhi kate vuttanayena pabbatāyasaddato dhātupa-ccayehi vibhattiyoti vibhatyuppattimhi kate rūpaṃ. Itaraṃtaṃsadisameva.

436.ru:
**537\. Īy’ ūpamānā ca** (912) \[V 6-7\].

	Upamānabhūtā nāmato **īya**ppaccayo hoti ācāratthe. Puna **upamāna**ggahaṇaṃ **kattu**ggahaṇanivattanatthaṃ, tena kammato pi sijjhati, sesaṃ samaṃ. Achattaṃ chattam iv’ ācarati chattīyati, aputtaṃ puttam iv’ ācarati puttīyati sissam ācariyo.

	**Upamānā** ti kiṃ? Dhammam ācarati.

**Ācāre** ti kiṃ? Achattaṃ chattam iva rakkhati.

	“Īyo” ti vattate.
436.nyasa:
(436) **¢yūpamānāca** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, upamānasmā nāmato īyapaccayo-hoti ācārattheti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ. Nāmaggahaṇañca ācāraggahaṇañcava-ttate. Atthosuviññeyyova. Caggahaṇa mācāraggahaṇānukaḍḍhanatthaṃ, tatthapayoja-naṃ heṭṭhāvuttameva. Satipi upamānaggahaṇe idhaupamānaggahaṇa karaṇaṃ kattuggahaṇa nivattanatthaṃ. *Chattīyati *puttīyatī tyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca chatīyatī
[p. 336]
tichattasaddato achattaṃchattamivaācaratītyatthe anantarasutta madhikicciminā īyapa-ccayaṃkatvā saralopapatibhāvādimhi katevuttanayenachattīyasaddatovibhatyuppa-ttimhikate rūpaṃ. Itaraṃpanataṃsadisameva. Kimudākaraṇāni suviññeyyāneva.

437.ru:
**538\. Nāmamhā ‘tticchatthe** (913) \[V 5\].

	Nāmamhā attano icchatthe **īya**ppaccayo hoti. Attano pattam icchati pattīyati, evaṃ vattīyati, parikkhārīyati, cīvarīyati, paṭīyati, dhanīyati, puttīyati.

	**Atticchatthe** ti kimatthaṃ? Aññassa pattam icchati.

	Daḷhaṃ karoti vīriyan ti[^204] atthe.

	**Kārita**ggahaṇam anuvattate.
437.nyasa: (437) **Nāmamhātticchatthe :** : Kimatthamidaṃ, nāmamhāatticchatthe īyapa-ccayohotītiñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Tyaggahaṇamihānuvattate. Attho suviññe-yyova. Attano icchāatticchā, atticchā yevaattho atticchāttho, tasmiṃ atticchatthe. Satipi nāmaggahaṇe idhanāmaggahaṇakaraṇaṃ upamānaggahaṇanivattanatthaṃ. *Pattīyatī tyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthacapattīyatītipattasaddato attano pattamiccha-tītyatthe anantasrasuttamadhikicciminā īyapaccayaṃkatvāsaralopa pakati bhāvañca katvā pattīyasaddato vuttanayena vibhatyuppattimhikaterūpaṃ. Itarāni taṃsadisāneva, kumudā haraṇampi suviññeyyameva.

438.nyasa:
(438) **Dhātuhi ṇeṇayaṇāpe ṇāpayakāritāni hetvatthe** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, sabbadhātūhi hetvatthe gamyamāneṇeṇayaṇāpeṇāpaya iccete paccayāhonti, tekāri-tasaññāca hontīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Catuppadamidaṃ. Atthoca viggahocasuviññe-yyova. *Kāretītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthacakāretīti kara karaṇetimassa bhūvādayodhātavoti laddhadhātusaññādissa dhātussantoloponekasarasseti luttānubandhassa yokocikaroti-tamañño karohi karohiccevaṃabravītyatthevā karontaṃ payojayatītyatthevā iminā ṇepaccayaṃ katvā tassacakāritasaññaṃ katvā kāritānaṃṇolopantiṇalopaṃkatvā asaṃyogantassa vuddhikāritetyādisarassavuddhiṃkatvā dhātupaccayehivibhatti yoti-vibhattiyo katvā tāsaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayena vattamānaparassapada paṭhamapurisekavacanasivibhattimhi kate rūpaṃ. Itarāni tīṇinayānuyogenasuviññe-yyāneva. Itaresucatūsaba-huvacana antivibhattiṃkatvā sarāsarelopanti vattamāne vāparoasarūpātivā kvacidhātu-vibhattipaccayānaṃdīghaviparītādesa lopāgamācetivā
[p. 337]
**6-Āchāta-Dutiyajaṇḍa**

paccayādimhisaralopakaraṇameva viseso. *Pācetītyādīsupaca pāketidhātumatta-mevaviseso. *Bhaṇetītyādīsupi aṭṭhasubhaṇa vaṇṇasaddebhaṇa bhaṇanetivā dhātuma-ttameva viseso. Kimudāharaṇānisuviññeyyāneva.

439.ru:
**539\. Dhāturūpe nāmasmā ṇayo ca** (919) \[V 12\].

	Dhātuyā rūpe nipphādetabbe, “taṃ karoti, tena atikkamati” icc ādike payujjitabbe vā sati nāmamhā[^205] **ṇaya**ppaccayo hoti, kāritasaññā ca. **Ṇ**alope, vibhattilopasaralopādīsu katesu vibhattuppatti, daḷhayati vīriyaṃ, evaṃ pamāṇayati, amissayati, tathā hatthinā atikkamati atihatthayati, vīṇāya upagāyati upavīṇayati, visuddhā hoti ratti visuddhayati, kusalaṃ pucchati kusalayati icc ādi.
439.nyasa: (439) **Dhāturupenāmasmā ṇayoca** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, dhāturūpesatinā-masmāṇayapaccayo hoti, tato kāritasaññācāti ñāpanatthaṃ. Catuppadamidaṃ. Kārita-ggahaṇamihānuvattate. Caggahaṇaṃtassānukaḍḍanatthaṃ, tatthapayojanaṃ heṭṭhā-vuttameva. Atthosuviññeyyova. Dhātuyārūpo dhāturūpo. Atikkamati, upagāyati. Karoti hotītyādīni, tasmiṃdhāturūpesatītisambandho. *Atihatthayatītyādinyudāhara-ṇāni, tatthaca atihatthayatīti atipubbasmāhatthīsaddatohatthināatikkamatītyatthe ana-ntarasuttamadhi kicciminā ṇayapaccayaṃkatvā tassakāritasaññañcakatvā kāritānaṃ ṇolopanti ṇalopaṃ katvā saralopa pakatibhāvādimhi kate rūpaṃ. Itarānitaṃsadisā-neva.

440.ru:
**445\. Bhāva-kammesu yo** (920) \[V 17\].

Sabbadhātūhi paro bhāva-kammesu[^14] **ya**ppaccayo hoti. Attanopadavisay’ evā ‘yam issate, “aññesu cā”[^15] ti sutte anuvattita-**vā**ggahaṇena **ya**ppaccaye vuddhi na bhavati, anubhūyate sukhaṃ Devadattena.

		Ākhyātena avuttattā, tatiyā hoti kattari;  
		Kammass’ ābhihitattā na, dutiyā paṭhamā ‘v’ idha.

Anubhūyante sampattiyo tayā. Anubhūyase tvaṃ Devadattena, anubhūyavhe tumhe. Ahaṃ anubhūye tayā, mayaṃ anubhūyāmhe.

“Kvaci dhātu” icc ādito “kvacī” ti vattamāne.
440.nyasa:
(440) **Bhāvakammesuyo** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, sabbehi dhātūhibhāvakammesu yapaccayo hotīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Dhātuggahaṇaṃvattate. Atthoca viggahoca suviññeyyova. Tatthaca bhāvonāma kevalo thavana lavana pacanādidhātvā ttho kammaṃnāma yaṃkaroti taṃkammantivuttaṃ. *Thīyatetyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca ṭhīyatetiṭhā gatinivattimhītimassa ṭhānantyatthe vattamānā tiantisithamimate antesevhe emhetityādīnaṃ vattamānasaññaṃ katvā vattamānāpaccuppanneti vattamā-napaccaye katvā tesaṃpyaniyamappasaṅge athapubbānivibhattīnaṃ chaparassapadā-nīti vattamāne parānyattano padānīti paresaṃchannaṃ attanopadasaññaṃkatvā attanopadānibhāvecakammanī tyattanopadaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyappasaṅge vuttanaye-nekavacanate vibhattiṃkatvā dhātūhiṇeṇayaṇāpeṇāpayakāritānihetvattheti vattamāne iminābhāve yapaccaye kateyamhi dādhāmāṭhāhāpāmahamaṭhādīnamīti dhātvantassī-kāre kate rūpaṃ. *Bujjhatetibudhabodhane, budhañāṇe, budhā avagamanetitiṇṇama-ññatarassa
[p. 338]
Vuttanayena attanopadānibhāvecakammanīti kammaniattanopadapaṭhama purisekava-canatevibhattiṃkatvā imināyapaccayañcakatvā idamevā dhikiccatassacavaggayakāra-vakārattaṃsadhātvantasseti dhātvantena sahayakārassacavaggaṃkatvā paradvebhāvo-thānetivattamāne vagge ghosāghosānaṃ tatiyapaṭhamā tidvabhāvekaterūpaṃ. *Paccate tipaca pāketimassa rūpaṃ. *Labbhatetilabha lābhetimassa vuttanayena kammani attanopada paṭhamapurisekavacanatevibhattiṃ katvā imināyapaccayaṃ katvā idamevādhikicca tassacavaggayakāravakārattaṃ sadhātvantassetyadhikicca pubbarūpañceti yakārassa pubbarūpaṃ katvā dodhassaceti etthacaggahaṇena pubbabhakārassa bakāraṃ katvā netabbenīterūpaṃ. *Karīyatetikarakaraṇetimassa vuttanayena tevibhattiṃkatvā imināya-paccayaṃkatvā pubbarūpañcetimassa vuttanayena suttadvayamadhikicca ivaṇṇāgamovātiyapaccayasmiṃ paredhātumhā ivaṇṇāgame kate rūpaṃ. *Ijjatetiyaja devapūjāsaṅgahakaraṇa dānadhammesūtimassa vuttanayena tevibhattiṃ katvā iminā yapaccayaṃ katvā yamhidādhāmāṭhāhāhāpāma-hamathādīnamītyadhikicca yajassādissīti dhātvādissikāraṃkatvā dhātvantenasahaya-kārassa vuttanayenacavaggaṃkatvā dvebhāvañca katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Uccatetiucaviyattiyaṃvācāyamiti massarūpaṃ. Kimudā-haraṇā nisuviññeyyāneva.

441.ru:
**447\. Tassa cavagga-yakāra-vakārattaṃ sadhātvantassa** (921) \[I 49\].

Tassa bhāva-kammavisayassa **ya**ppaccayassa **ca**vagga-**ya**kāra-**va**kārattaṃ hoti dhātvantena saha yathāsambhavaṃ. Ettha ca “ivaṇṇāgamo vā” ti ito sīhagatiyā **vā**saddo anuvattetabbo, so ca vavatthitavibhāsattho. Tena:

		**Ca**vaggo **ca-ta**vaggānaṃ, dhātvantānaṃ **ya-va**ttanaṃ;  
		**Ra-vā**nañ ca sayappaccayānaṃ hoti yathākkaman ti.

Dhātvantassa **ca**vaggādittā **ca**kāre kate “paradvebhāvo ṭhāne” ti **ca**kārassa dvittaṃ. Paccate odano devadattena, “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā garupubbarassato parassa paṭhamapurisabahuvacanassa kvaci **re** hoti. Paccare, paccante. Paccase, paccavhe. Pacce, paccāmhe.

Parassapadādese paccati, paccanti. Paccasi, paccatha. Paccāmi, paccāma. Tathā kammakattari paccate odano sayam eva, paccante. Paccati, paccanti vā icc ādi.

Gamito kammani attanopade, **ya**ppaccaye ca kate.

“Dhātūhi,” “tasmiṃ,” “ye” ti ca vattate.
441.nyasa:
(441) **Tassacavaggayakāravakārattaṃsadhātvantassa** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, tassayapaccayassadhātvantenasahacavaggayakāravakārattaṃ hotīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tip-adamidaṃ. Yakāraggahaṇamihānuvattate. Atthocaviggahoca suviññeyyova. *Vuccate tyādīnyu-dāharaṇāni tatthacavuccatetiuca viyattiyaṃvācāyamitimassa vuttanayena attanopadapa-ṭhama purisekavacana tevibhattiṃkatvā bhāvakammesuyotiyapacca-yaṃkatvā tamevādhikicciminā dhātvantenasahayakārassa ca vaggaṃkatvā paradve-bhāvoṭhāneti dvebhāvaṃkatvā kvacādimajjhutarānaṃ dīgharassāpaccayesucātiva-ttamāne tesuvuddhilopāgamavikāra viparītādesāceti ādimhi vakārāgamaṃkatvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. Itaresaṃdvinnaṃ vakārāgamābhāvova viseso. *Majjatetimaja
[p. 339]
6-Āchāta-Dutiyakaṇḍa

saṃsuddhimhi, majaparimajjaneti dvinnamaññatarassa rūpaṃ. *Paccatetipacapāketi ma-ssarūpaṃ. *Bujjhatetibudha bodhanetimassa rūpaṃ. *Yujjatetiyuja yojeti massa rūpaṃ. *Kujjhatetikudhakopetimassa. *Ujjhatetiudha ussaggetimassarūpaṃ. *Haññte-tihanahiṃ sāgatīsūti massavuttanayena tevibhattaṃ katvā yapaccayañcakatvā vuttanayena iminā dhātvantena sahayakārassa cavagge kate rūpaṃ. *Kayyatetikara karaṇetimassavuttanayena tevibhattimhikate yapaccayādimhicakahevuttanayena iminādhātvantena sahayakārassa yakārekateparadvebhāvoṭhānetimassadvibhāve-katerūpaṃ. *Dibbatetidivu kīḷā vijigīsā byavahāra juti thuti gatīsūti massa vuttanayena tevibhattimhikate yapaccayecakate iminā dhātvantenasahayakārassa vakārekate vuttanayena dvibhāvekate dodhassaceti ettha caggahaṇena vakāradvayassa bakāradvaye kate rūpaṃ.

442.ru:
**448\. Ivaṇṇāgamo vā** (922) \[VI 37\].

Sabbehi dhātūhi tasmiṃ bhāva-kammavisaye **ya**ppaccaye pare ivaṇṇāgamo hoti vā ti **ī**kārāgamo. Vavatthitavibhāsattho ‘yaṃ **vā**saddo. **Cchā**deso, gacchīyate gāmo Devadattena, gacchīyante. Gacchīyase, gacchīyavhe. Gacchīye, gacchīyāmhe.

**Cchā**desābhāve.

“Dhātūhi,” “yo,” “vā” ti ca vattate.
442.nyasa: (442) **Ivaṇṇāgamovā** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, sabbadhātūhitamhiya paccaye pare ivaṇṇāgamo hoti vikappenāti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Dhātuggahaṇañcaya-ggahaṇañca taggahaṇañca vattate. Attho suviññeyyo vaviggahoca. Kariyyatetyādī-nyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca kariyyateti karakaraṇetimassa vuttanayena attanopadapaṭha-mapurisekavacana tevibhattiṃkatvā paccayañca katvā dhātūhiṇeṇayaṇāpeṇāpaya kāritāni hetvatthe tyadhikicca anantarasuttadvayañcādhi kicciminā ivaṇṇāgamaṃ-katvā paradvebhāvoṭhāneti yakārassadvibhāvekaterūpaṃ. *Kariyyatītiettha kvacidhātuvibhatti paccayānaṃ dīghaviparītādesa lopāgamāceti vattamāne attano padāni parassapadattanti attanopadassaparassapadabhāvakaraṇameva viseso itarāni dvegamusappagatimhītimassa vuttanayena tevibhatyādimhi katerūpaṃ, gamissanto-cchovāsabbāsūtidhātvantassacchādeso vaviseso. Kimudāharaṇaṃ heṭṭhāvuttameva.

443.ru:
**449\. Pubbarūpañ ca** (923) \[I 49\].

Heṭṭh’ ānuttehi parass’ ev’ edaṃ, tena **ka-ca-ṭa**\-**pa**vagga-**ya**kāra-**la-sa**nteh’ eva dhātūhi paro **ya**ppaccayo pubbarūpam āpajjate vā ti **ma**kārā parassa **ya**kārassa **ma**kāro. Gammate, gamīyate, gammante, gamīyante. Gammase, gamīyase, gammavhe, gamīyavhe. Gamme, gamīye, gammāmhe, gamīyāmhe.

**Parassapadatte:** gacchīyyati, gacchīyyanti. Gacchīyati, gacchīyanti vā. Gammati, gammanti. Gamīyati, gamīyanti. **I**kārāgame gamiyyati, gamiyyanti. Tathā ghammīyati, ghammīyanti icc ādi.

Vattamānāvibhatti.
443.nyasa:
(443) **Pubbarūpañca** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, sabbehi dhātūhi yapaccayo pubbarūpamāpajjatevikappenātiñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Dhātuggahaṇañcaya-ggahaṇañca vāggahaṇañcavattate. Atthoca viggahoca suviññeyyova.
[p. 340]
caggahaṇaṃvāggahaṇānukaḍḍhanatthaṃ. *Vuḍḍhatetyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca vuḍḍhateti vaḍḍhavaḍḍhanetimassa vuttanayena attanopadapaṭhamapurise kavacana tevibhattimhi kate yapaccayeca kate anantarasuttassaviya suttadvayamadhikicciminā yapaccayassa pubbarūpaṃkatvā kvacidhātuvibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparītā desa lopā gamāceti vakāreakārassa ukāraṃkatvā tanevavābyañjanocavisaññogoti etthaca-ggahaṇenavā pubbaḍakārassalopaṃkatvā hacatutthānamantānaṃdodheti vattamāne ḍoḍhakāreti catutthassa ḍhakārassa ḍakāraṃkatvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Phallatetiphalanipphattimhītimassarūpaṃ. *Dammaxteti damudamanetimassarūpaṃ. *Labbhatetilabbhalābhetimassa-rūpaṃ.*Sakkatetisakapūjāyaṃ, sakasāmatthetidvinna-maññatarassarūpaṃ. Dissateti disapekkhanetimassarūpaṃ.

444.ru:
**511\. Tathā kattari ca** (924) \[I 49\].

	Yathā bhāva-kammesu **ya**ppaccayass’ ādeso hoti, tathā kattari pi **ya**ppaccayassa sadhātvantassa **ca**vagga-**ya**kāra-**va**kārādeso, pubbarūpañ kātabbānī ti dhātvantassa **va**karattā saha tena **ya**kārassa **va**kāre kate dvibhāvo, “do dhassa cā”[^129] ti ettha **ca**ggahaṇena “bo vassā” ti vuttattā **va**karadvayassa **ba**kāradvayaṃ, dibbati, dibbanti; dibbasi, dibbatha; dibbāmi, dibbāma.

	**Kamme** dibbate, dibbante. Dibbati, dibbanti.

Dibbatu. Dibbataṃ. Dibbe. Dibbetha. Dibbi. Adibbittha. Dibbissati. Dibbissate. Adibbissa icc ādi.

	**Sivu** tantasantāne,[^130] sibbati, sibbanti. Sibbatu. Sibbeyya. Asibbi, sibbi. Sibbissati. Asibbissa icc ādi.

	**Pada** gatimhi, **u**pubbo dvittaṃ, “tathā kattari cā”[^131] ti sadhātvantassa **ya**kārassa **ja**kāro, dvittañ ca.

	Uppajjati, uppajjanti. Uppajjate, uppajjante, uppajjare.

	**Kamme** paṭipajjate, paṭipajjante. Paṭipajjati, paṭipajjanti.

	**Bhāve** uppajjate tayā.

	Tathā uppajjatu. Uppajjeyya. Udapajjā. Udapajjatha. Udapādi,[^132] uppajjī. Uppajjittha. Uppajjissati. Uppajjissa, uppajjissā icc ādi.

	**Budha** avagamane, **ya**ppaccayaparattā na vuddhi, **jha**kārādeso ‘va viseso, dhammaṃ bujjhati, bujjhanti. Bujjhate, bujjhante, bujjhare vā.

	**Kamme** bujjhate mayā dhammo, bujjhante.

Bujjhati, bujjhanti. Bujjhatu. Bujjheyya. Abujjhi. Abujjhittha. Bujjhissati. Abujjhissa.

	**Yudha** sampahāre, yujjhati, yujjhanti.

	**Kudha** kope, kujjhati, kujjhanti.

	**Vidha** tāḷane, vijjhati, vijjhanti icc ādi.

	**Naha** bandhane, “havipariyayo”[^133] ti yogavibhāgena vipariyayo. Sannayhati, sannayhanti icc ādi.

	**Mana** ñāṇe, **ñ**ādeso ‘va viseso, maññati, maññanti icc ādi.

	**Dā** ādāne, **saṃ-ā**pubbo “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā **ya**mhi dhātvantassa **i**kāro,[^134] sīlaṃ samādiyati,[^135] samādiyanti icc ādi.

	**Tusa** pītimhi, **ya**ppaccayassa pubbarūpattaṃ, tussati, tussanti icc ādi.

	Tathā **samu** upasame, sammati, sammanti.

	**Kupa** kope, kuppati, kuppanti.

	**Jana** janane, “janādīnam ā timhi cā”[^136] ti ettha “janādīnam ā” ti yogavibhāgena **ya**mhi dhātvantassa **ā**kāro.[^137] Jāyati, jāyanti. Jāyate, jāyante.

	**Kamme** janīyati, janīyanti.

Jāyatu. Jāyeyya. Ajāyi, ajani. Jāyissati, janissati. Ajāyissa, ajanissa icc ādi.

Divādigaṇo.

**Svādigaṇa.**

	**Su** savaṇe, pure viya vibhattuppatti.
444.nyasa:
(444) **Tathā kattarica**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, yathā heṭṭhābhāva kammesuya-paccayassādeso hoti, tathā kattaripihotīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ. Caggahaṇaṃ vuttappakārānukaḍḍhanatthaṃ. Yaggahaṇañca cavaggayakāravakāraggahaṇañca pubbarūpaggahaṇañca vattate. Attho suviññeyyova. *Bujjhatītibudha bodhanetima-ssavuttanayena tyādīnaṃ vattamānasaññaṃkatvā vattamānāpaccuppanneti vattamā-napaccaye katvā tesaṃ pyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenā dimhichannaṃ parassapada-saññaṃ katvā kattariparassapadanti parassapadaṃkatvā tassāpyaniyamappasaṅge vuttanayenapaṭhama-purisekavacana tivibhattiṃkatvā idamevādhikicca divāditoyoti yapaccayaṃkatvā tassaca bhāvakammesu yotassa cavaggayakāravakārattaṃ sadhā-tvantassa pubbarūpañcātivattamāne iminādhātvantena sahacavaggaṃkatvā paradve-bhāvoṭhāneti vattamāne vaggeghosā ghosānaṃ tatiyapaṭhamātitassa dvebhāvekate netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Vijjhatītividha vibhāgetimassarūpaṃ. *Maññatīti manañāṇeti-massa rūpaṃ. *Sibbatītisiputantasantā netimassa vuttanayenativibhattiṃkatvā tapa-ccayañcakatvā iminādhātvantena sahatassa-vakārañcakatvā vuttanayena dvibhā-vañcakatvā dodhassaceti ettha caggahaṇenavakāradvayassa bakāradvayamhikate-rūpaṃ.
[p. 341]
6-Āchāta-Dutiyakaṇḍa

445.ru:
**433\. Bhūvādito a** (925) \[V 18\].

**Bhū** icc evamādito dhātugaṇato paro **a**paccayo hoti kattari vihitesu vibhattippaccayesu paresu. Sabbadhātukamhi yev’ āyam issate.

“Asaṃyogantassa,” “vuddhī” ti ca vattate.
445.nyasa: (445) **Bhūvādito a**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, bhūiccevamādito dhātugaṇato apaccayohoti kattarīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ, kattariggahaṇamihānuvattate. Atthocaviggahoca suviññeyyova. *Bhavatītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca bhavatīti bhūsa-ttāyamiti massavuttanayenativibhattiṃkatvā anantarasuttamadhikicciminā dhātutoapa-ccayaṃkatvā asaṃyogantassa vuddhikāri kativattamāne aññesucāti dhātvantassa vuddhi-ṃkatvā oavasareti okārassa avādesṃkatvā rūpasiddhiveditabbā. *Paṭhatītipaṭhaviyattiyaṃ vācāyamitimassarūpaṃ. *Pacatītipaca pāketimassarūpaṃ, *jayatītiji jayetimassa-rūpaṃ. Etthaca oavasaretyadhikicca eayādesova viseso.

446.ru:
**509\. Rudhādito niggahīta pubbañ ca** (926) \[V 19\].

	Catuppadam idaṃ. **Rudha** icc evamādito dhātugaṇato **a**ppaccayo hoti kattari vibhatti-ppaccayesu niggahītañ ca tato pubbaṃ hutvā āgamo hoti, tañ ca niggahītaṃ pakatiyā sarānugatattā dhātussarato paraṃ hoti. **Ca**saddena **i-ī-e-o**paccayā ca,[^121] niggahītassa vaggantattaṃ. Idha saṃyogantattā na vuddhi hoti, tadāgamassa taggahaṇena gahaṇato.[^122]

	So maggaṃ rundhati, rundhanti; rundhasi, rundhatha; rundhāmi, rundhāma. Rundhate, rundhante icc ādi. **I**kārādippaccayesu pana rundhiti, rundhīti, rundheti, rundhotī ti pi hoti.

	**Kamme** **ni**pubbo **ya**ppaccayassa “tassa cavagga”[^123] icc ādinā sadhātvantassa **jha**kāre kate “vagge ghosā”[^124] ti ādinā dvittaṃ, maggo nirujjhate tena, nirujjhante. **Parassapadatte** nirujjhati, nirujjhanti; nirujjhasi, nirujjhatha; nirujjhāmi, nirujjhāma.

	Rundhatu, rundhantu; rundhāhi, rundhatha; rundhāmi, rundhāma. Rundhataṃ, rundhantaṃ; rundhassu, rundhavho; rundhe, rundhāmase. Nirujjhataṃ, nirujjhantaṃ; nirujjhatu, nirujjhantu.

Rundhe, rundheyya, rundheyyuṃ; rundhetha, rundheraṃ. Nirujjhetha, nirujjheyya icc ādi. Rundhi, rundhiṃsu. Arundhi; nirujjhittha. Nirujjhi, nirujjhiṃsu. Rundhissati, rundhissanti. Nirujjhissate, nirujjhissante. Nirujjhissati, nirujjhissanti. Arundhissa, arundhissaṃsu. Nirujjhissatha, nirujjhissa icc ādi.

	**Chidi** dvidhākaraṇe, chindati, chindanti. **Kamme** chijjate, chijjante. Chijjati, chijjanti. Tathā chindatu, chindantu. Chijjatu, chijjantu. Chinde, chindeyya. Chijjeyya. Achindi, chindi, chindiṃsu. Achijjittha, chijji. Chindissati, chindissanti. **Ss**assa **chā**dese: checchati, checchanti.[^125] Checchiti vā. **Kamme** chijjissate, chijjissante. Chijjissati, chijjissanti. Achindissa. Achijjissa icc ādi.

	**Bhidi** vidāraṇe, bhindati, bhindanti icc ādi.

	**Yuja** yoge, yuñjati, yuñjanti. Yujjate, yujjante. Yujjati, yujjanti. Yuñjatu. Yujjataṃ. Yuñje. Yujjetha. Ayuñji, ayuñjiṃsu. Ayujjittha, ayujji. Yuñjissati, yuñjissanti. Yujjissate, yujjissante. Yujjissati, yujjissanti. Ayuñjissa. Ayujjissatha, ayujjissa icc ādi.

	**Bhuja** pālana-byavaharaṇesu, bhuñjati, bhuñjanti icc ādi.

	**Bhavissantiyaṃ** “karassa sappaccayassa kāho”[^126] ti sutte **sappaccaya**ggahaṇena bhujato **ssa**ssa **khā**deso, “ko khe cā”[^127] ti dhātvantassa **ka**kāro, vuddhi, bhokkhati,[^128] bhokkhanti. Bhokkhasi, bhokkhatha. Bhokkhāmi, bhokkhāma. **Khā**desābhāve bhuñjissati, bhuñjissanti icc ādi.

	**Muca** mocane, muñcati, muñcanti. Muccate, muccante. Muñcatu, muñcantu. Muccataṃ, muccantaṃ. Muñce, muñceyya, muñceyyuṃ. Muccetha, mucceraṃ. Amuñci, amuñciṃsu. Amuccittha. Mokkhati, mokkhanti. Muñcissati, muñcissanti. Muccissate, muccissante. Amuñcissa, amuccissatha icc ādi.

Rudhādigaṇo.

**Divādigaṇa**.

	**Divu** kīḷā-vijigīsā-byavahāra-juti-thuti-kanti-gatīsu. Pure viya dhātvantalopavibhattuppattiyo.
446.nyasa: (446) **Rudhāditoniggahītapubbañca**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, rudhaicceva mādi-to dhātugaṇato apaccayo hoti kattari. Niggahīta pubbañca hutvā āgamohotīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Catuppadamidaṃ. Kattariggahaṅañca aggahaṇañcavattate. Caggahaṇaṃ dutiyatthasampiṇḍanatthaṃ. Attho ca viggahoca suviññeyyova. Idhacaniggahītanti vattabbe se-satolopaṃ gasipītyadhikicca sabbāsamāvuso pasagganipātādīhiceti vibhattilopaṃkatvāvā kvacilopantivattamāne byañjaneceti niggahītalopaṃkatvāvā evaṃvuttantidaṭṭhabbaṃ. Niggahītañceti satipiniggahītā gameniccavidhānatthaṃ idhaniggahītaggahaṇaṃkataṃ. *Rundhatītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca rundhatītirudha āvaraṇetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa vuttanayena tivibhattiṃ katvā tathākattarica bhūvāditoaityadhikicciminā apaccayaṃ katvā niggahītapubbañca katvā tassaaṃbya-ñjaneniggahītanti vattamāne vaggantaṃvāggetivaggantaṃ katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Chindatītichidi dvidhākaraṇetimassarūpaṃ Bhindatitobhididvidhākaranetimassa rupaṃ.

447.ru:
**510\. Divādito yo** (928) \[V 21\].

	**Divā**dito dhātugaṇato **ya**ppaccayo hoti kattari vihitesu vibhatti-ppaccayesu.

	“**Ya**ggahaṇaṃ,” “cavagga **ya**kāra-**va**kārattaṃ sadhātvantassa,” “pubbarūpan” ti ca vattate.
447.nyasa:
(447) **Divāditoyo**: : Kimatthamidaṃ, divādito dhātugaṇato yapaccayo-hoti kattaīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Kattariggahaṇamihānuvattate. Atthocavi-ggahoca suviññeyyova. *Dibbatītyādī nyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca dibbatītidipu kīḷāvijigīsābyavahāra
[p. 342]
jutithutigatīsūtimassa vuttanayena tivibhattaṃkatvā tathākattarīcāti vattamāne imi-nāyapaccayaṃ katvā bhāvakammesuyo tassacavaggayakāravakārattaṃ sadhātvantassa pubbarūpañceti vattamānetathākattariceti dhātvantana sahayakārassaca vakāraṃ katvā tassa vuttanayena dvibhāvañca katvā vakāradvayassa bakāradvayañca katvā netabbe nīte rūpaṃ. *Sibbatītisivutantasantānetimassa rūpaṃ. *Yujjhatītiyudha sampahāreti-massarūpaṃ. *Vijjhatīti vidhavibhāgetimassarūpaṃ. *Bujjhatītibudhabodhanetimassa rūpaṃ.

448.ru:
**512\. Svādito ṇu-ṇā-uṇā ca** (929) \[V 25\].

	**Su** icc evamādito dhātugaṇato **ṇu ṇā uṇā** icc ete paccayā honti kattari vihitesu vibhatti-ppaccayesu. “Aññesu cā”[^138] ti ettha **ca**ggahaṇena **ṇ**uppaccayassa vuddhi. Tatth’ ev’ ānuvattita-**vā**ggahaṇena svādīnaṃ **ṇu**\-**ṇā**dīsu na vuddhi.

	Dhammaṃ suṇoti, saralopādi, suṇanti; suṇosi, suṇotha; suṇomi, suṇoma. **Nā**paccaye suṇāti, suṇanti; suṇāsi, “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā rassattaṃ, suṇasi, suṇātha, suṇatha; suṇāmi, suṇāma.

	**Kamme** **ya**ppaccaye “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā dīgho,[^139] sūyate, sūyante. Sūyati, sūyanti. Dvitte rassattaṃ, suyyati, suyyanti; sūyyati, sūyyanti vā.

	Suṇotu, suṇantu; suṇohi, suṇotha; suṇomi, suṇoma. Suṇātu, suṇantu; suṇa, suṇāhi, suṇātha; suṇāmi, suṇāma. Suṇataṃ, suṇantaṃ; suṇassu, suṇavho; suṇe, suṇāmase. **Kamme** sūyataṃ, sūyantaṃ. Sūyatu, sūyantu.

	Suṇe, suṇeyya, suṇeyyuṃ; suṇeyyāsi, suṇeyyātha; suṇeyyāmi, suṇeyyāma. Suṇetha, suṇeraṃ; suṇetho, suṇeyyāvho; suṇeyyaṃ, suṇeyyāmhe. Sūyetha, sūyeyya.

	Asuṇi, suṇi, asuṇiṃsu, suṇiṃsu. Asuṇi, asuṇittha. Asuṇiṃ, suṇiṃ, asuṇimha, suṇimha. Asuṇittha, suṇittha. **Ṇā**paccayalopo, vuddhi, **sa**ssa dvibhāve, **s**āgamo, assosi, assosiṃsu, paccassosuṃ.[^140] Assosi, assosittha. Assosiṃ, assosimha, assosimhā,[^141] vā, assosittha. Asūyittha, asūyi.

	Saralopādi, suṇissati, suṇissanti; suṇissasi, suṇissatha; suṇissāmi, suṇissāma. Suṇissate, suṇissante; suṇissase, suṇissavhe; suṇissaṃ, suṇissāmhe. **Ṇā**paccayalopo, vuddhi, sossati, sossanti; sossasi, sossatha; sossāmi, sossāma. Sossate. Sūyissate, sūyissati. Asuṇissa. Asūyissa icc ādi.

	**Hi** gatimhi, **pa**pubbo **ṇā**paccayo, pahiṇāti, pahiṇati vā, pahiṇanti. Pahiṇātu, pahiṇantu. Pahiṇeyya. Pahiṇi, dūtaṃ pāhesi.[^142] Pahiṇissati. Pahiṇissa icc ādi.

	**Vu** saṃvaraṇe, āvuṇāti, āvuṇanti icc ādi.

	**Mi** pakkhepe, “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā **ṇa**ssa **na**ttaṃ, minoti, minanti icc ādi.

	**Apa** pāpuṇane, **pa**pubbo saralope “dighan” ti dīgho, **uṇā**paccayo,[^143] sampattiṃ pāpuṇāti, pāpuṇanti. Pāpuṇāsi, pāpuṇātha; pāpuṇāmi, pāpuṇāma.

	**Kamme** pāpīyati, pāpīyanti. Tathā pāpuṇātu. Pāpīyatu. Pāpuṇe, pāpuṇeyya. Pāpīyeyya. Pāpuṇi, pāpuṇiṃsu. Pāpīyi. Pāpuṇissati. Pāpīyissati. Pāpuṇissa. Pāpīyissa icc ādi.

	**Saka** sattimhi, dvibhāvo, sakkuṇāti,[^144] sakkuṇanti. **Bhāve** “pubbarūpañ cā”[^145] ti pubbarūpattaṃ, sakkate tayā, sakkati vā. Sakkuṇātu. Sakkuṇeyya. “Kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā **saka**ntassa **khā**deso ajjatanādimhi,[^146] asakkhi,[^147] sakkhi, asakkhiṃsu, sakkhiṃsu. Sakkhissati, sakkhissanti. Asakkhissa, asakkhissaṃsu icc ādi.

Svādigaṇo.

**Kiyādigaṇa.**

	**Kī** dabbavinimaye, **vi**pubbo dvittaṃ, pure viya vibhattuppatti.
448.nyasa: (448) **Svādito ṇuṇā uṇāca** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, suiccevamāditodhātugaṇa-to ṇuṇā uṇāiccetepaccayā honti kattarīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Tipadamidaṃ. Kattariggahaṇa mihā-nu vattate. Atthoca viggahocasuviññeyyova. Caggahaṇaṃpaccayattayaṃ sampi-ṇḍeti. Suṇotītyādīnyudāharaṇāni. Tatthaca *abhisuṇotīti abhipubbassasu abhissave, susavanetidvinna maññatarassa laddhadhātusaññādissavuttanayena tivibhattiṃ katvā tathākatta-ricetyadhikicciminā ṇupaccayaṃkatvā asaṃyovantassa vuddhikārite tyadhikicca aññesucāti ettha caggahaṇena ṇupaccayantassa vuddhimhi katerūpaṃ. *Abhisuṇātīti tassevadhātussa ṇāpaccaye katerūpaṃ. *Saṃvuṇotītisaṃpubbassa vusaṃvaraṇe himassa-ṇupaccaye katerūpaṃ. saṃvuṇātītitassodhātussa napaccaye katerupaṃ. *Āvuṇotīti ettha upasaggovaviseso. *Pāpuṇātītipapubbassa āpapāpuṇa-netimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa vuttanayenativibhattiṃkatvā imināuṇāpacca-yekaterūpaṃ.

449.ru:
**513\. Kiyādito nā** (930) \[V 23-4\].

	**Kī** icc evamādito dhātugaṇato **nā**paccayo hoti kattari. **Nā**parattā na vuddhi, “kvaci dhātū” ti ādinā kiyādīnaṃ **nā**mhi rassattaṃ,[^148] kīto **nā**paccaya-**n**akārassa **ṇa**ttañ ca.

	Bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇāti, vikkhiṇanti. Vikkīyati, vikkīyanti. Vikkiṇātu, vikkiṇantu. Vikkīyatu, vikkīyantu. Vikkiṇe, vikkiṇeyya. Vikkīyeyya, vikkīyeyyuṃ. Avikkiṇi, vikkiṇi. Vikkīyittha, vikkīyi. Vikkiṇissati, vikkiṇissanti. Vikkīyissati, vikkīyissanti. Avikkiṇissa, avikkiṇissaṃsu. Vikkīyissa, vikkīyissaṃsu icc ādi.

	**Ji** jaye, kilese jināti, jinanti. Jīyati, jīyanti. Evaṃ jinātu. Jīyatu. Jineyya. Jīyeyya. Ajini, jini, ajiniṃsu, jiniṃsu. Ajesi, ajesuṃ. Ajinittha. Ajīyittha, ajīyi. Jinissati, jinissanti. Vijessati, vijessanti. Jīyissati, jīyissanti. Ajinissa. Ajīyissa icc ādi.

	Tathā **ci** caye, cināti, cinanti icc ādi.

	**Ñā** avabodhane **nā**paccayo**.**

	“Vā” ti vattate.
449.nyasa:
(449) **Kīyādito nā** : : Kimatthamidaṃ, kī iccevamādito dhātugaṇatonā-paccayo hoti kattarīti ñāpanatthaṃ. Dvipadamidaṃ. Kattariggahaṇamihā-nuvattate. Atthoca-viggahoca suviññeyyova. *Kiṇātītyādīnyudāharaṇāni, tatthaca kiṇātītikīda-bbavini yogetimassa laddhadhātusaññādissa vuttanayena vattamānaparassa padapa-ṭhamapurisekavacanativibhattiṃ katvā tathākattaricetyadhikicciminā nāpacca-yekate kvacādimajjhuttarā-naṃ dīgharassā paccayesucāti
[p. 343]
ādisarassa rassekate kvacidhā kvadinā nassaṇaṇa kāre katerūpaṃ. * Jinātītiji jayeti-massa rūpaṃ. * Dhunātīti dhūkampaneti massa rūpaṃ. *Munātīti mūbandhaneti massa rūpaṃ. Lunātīti lūchedanetimassarūpaṃ. * punātīti pūpavaneti massarūpaṃ.
